sessions.title: From Vector Search to Private Agent Factory: Enterprise AI on Oracle AI Database
sessions.description: Oracle AI Database provides a complete foundation for building enterprise AI applications. In this session, start with AI Vector Search fundamentals—learn how to generate embeddings, store and query vectors using the VECTOR data type, and implement similarity search. Then dive deeper into Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), including architecture patterns, RAG using PL/SQL, and integration with frameworks like LangChain. Finally, explore how Private Agent Factory simplifies enterprise AI development with a no-code platform for RAG workflows, AI agents, and MCP integration. See how to move from low-level vector operations to secure, enterprise-ready AI agents running close to your data inside the database.

sessions.title: Zero Trust Security with OCI
sessions.description: Master the principles of Zero Trust security and apply them across OCI to ensure no user, device, or workload is implicitly trusted. Through hands-on labs, you'll implement continuous verification using OCI Identity Domains, enforce least-privilege access with IAM policies, segment networks with Security Lists and Network Firewalls, and protect sensitive data using OCI Vault and Data Safe. You'll leverage Cloud Guard and Security Zones to detect misconfigurations, automate threat responses, and enforce security postures in real time. By the end of the course, you'll have the skills to design and operate a Zero Trust architecture on OCI, verifying every request and securing critical assets at every layer of the stack.

Explore release 26C capabilities for creating and extending AI agents with natural-language tools, orchestrating workflows, validating behavior, and managing agents across Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM. See how agents use trusted enterprise context while honoring Fusion security, approvals, and business rules. Leave with a practical understanding of how to build, test, govern, and deploy agents that support supply chain processes at scale.

sessions.title: Lessons Learned in Operationalizing and Scaling Agents Across the Enterprise
sessions.description: As enterprises move from pilot projects to real-world deployment, the conversation is shifting from what agents can do to how they can be operationalized, governed, and scaled with confidence. Explore the practical lessons learned in building enterprise-grade agent experiences, from choosing the right use cases and establishing trust, to integrating agents with business processes, data, and existing systems. Hear what it takes to move beyond isolated demos and create durable agentic solutions that can deliver measurable business value, support human oversight, and adapt as business needs evolve. This session will offer actionable takeaways to help teams start their own agentic journeys with a clearer path to scale.

sessions.title: From UX to AX: Oracle’s Evolving User Experience Approach
sessions.description: As AI transforms enterprise software, Oracle is evolving the user experience from traditional interactions to AX—agentic experiences designed to understand intent, anticipate user needs, and help people take action through delegation. Explore how AX is taking shape in the new Agentic Fusion Home and across Oracle’s user experiences, bringing together intelligent agents, and orchestrated workflows. Learn how Oracle is designing these experiences to simplify complex work while preserving clarity, trust, transparency, and user control. For anyone exploring the intersection of AI and enterprise UX, this session offers an inside look behind Oracle’s human-centered approach to building useful, connected, and future-ready agentic experiences.

sessions.title: Feed the Beast: Storage Strategies for AI at Scale
sessions.description: AI is reshaping infrastructure requirements, making storage a critical foundation for every stage of the AI lifecycle. Learn how OCI Storage is evolving to support AI workloads—from data preparation and model training to inference and production deployment. This session explores Oracle’s storage vision, strategy, and roadmap, including innovations that will redefine how customers access and scale AI data, while highlighting the technologies that simplify data management, optimize performance, and power the next generation of AI infrastructure on OCI.

sessions.title: DBA in the Driver's Seat: Operating Autonomous AI Database
sessions.description: What does the DBA role look like when the database handles much of its own routine administration? Autonomous AI Database gives DBAs the opportunity to spend less time maintaining individual databases and more time operating a secure, resilient, and efficient database service. This session explores what Oracle automates, what remains under DBA control, and where database expertise becomes even more valuable. Learn how DBAs can govern access, protect sensitive information, manage development and testing environments, oversee performance and workloads, plan for business continuity, and control resource consumption across the database estate.

sessions.title: Recover with Confidence: Modern Data Protection for Cyber Resilience
sessions.description: Traditional backups may no longer be sufficient in an era of AI cyber threats, cloud-scale operations, and always-on business requirements. Organizations need a cyber resilience strategy that protects critical data, enables rapid recovery, and reduces operational risk. This session explores how Recovery Manager (RMAN), Zero Data Loss Recovery Appliance (ZDLRA), and Recovery Service (ZRCV) help deliver resilient, scalable data protection for on-premises and OCI/multicloud environments. Learn how enterprises use real-time protection, immutable architectures, intelligent automation, and AI-powered recovery insights to strengthen cyber resilience, help accelerate recovery, and improve confidence in meeting business continuity objectives.

sessions.title: Own the AI Whitespace: Build and Scale OpenAI-Powered Solutions on Oracle Marketplace
sessions.description: AI winners will be the ISVs that build what customers cannot buy off the shelf. Learn how to turn whitespace across customer data, applications, and workflows into differentiated OpenAI-powered solutions on OCI. See how Oracle Marketplace—through compelling listings, Private Offers, and, where available, Multi-Party Private Offers—can help you package, sell, and scale those offerings. Leave with a practical blueprint for turning one AI deployment into repeatable revenue.

sessions.title: Oracle: Where AI Means Business
sessions.description: AI is abundant. Trust is hard to come by. Proven value is harder still. But put AI inside the systems organizations already rely on, grounded in trusted data, governed by enterprise controls, and connected to the processes that run the business, and something changes. AI becomes useful. It understands context, acts across workflows, and delivers outcomes people can see and measure. That’s where Oracle makes the difference: bringing AI and trusted data into the applications people use every day. Witness it live: immersive demos, candid customer conversations, and proof you can see on screen and in real-world results.
deliveryTypes: In Person Livestream And On Demand

sessions.title: AI World Hub Open
sessions.description: Where the Oracle community comes together to see, try, and talk through the products and technologies that are helping turn AI into meaningful business outcomes. Explore new ideas, learn from experts, and engage in the experiences that make AI World a must-attend event.

sessions.title: 1+1 = 3 with Oracle Utilities Data Intelligence and Fusion Data Intelligence
sessions.description: Utilities are under pressure to deliver faster insights, more connected experiences, and true operational agility. This session reveals how Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI) and Oracle Utilities Data Intelligence, each powerful on its own, become transformational when combined. Built on a common OCI foundation, these platforms seamlessly unify financial, customer, meter, and asset data, breaking down silos and enabling proactive, data-driven action. Join Oracle experts to discover real-world scenarios like revenue intelligence and asset optimization, delivering breakthrough outcomes for your utility, your customers, and your team. See why, with Oracle, 1+1 really can equal 3.

sessions.title: From Agents to Agentic Financial Services Applications
sessions.description: Financial services institutions are moving beyond task-specific agents toward agentic applications that understand intent, reason over trusted enterprise data, coordinate work, and help users act in real time. This session explores how Oracle technologies can bring industry knowledge, semantic business context, intelligent automation and cloud-native services together across customer service, lending, collections, operations, cash management, risk and compliance. Attendees will learn how agentic applications improve productivity, accelerate decisions, reduce operational friction, strengthen governance and deliver more personalized customer experiences, while preserving the security, explainability, and trust required in financial services.

sessions.title: Four Clouds, One Convo: OCI, AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Leaders on What's Next
sessions.description: Multicloud has shifted from a hedge against lock-in to a deliberate enterprise strategy — and adoption is accelerating. In this panel, product leaders from Oracle and its partners at AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud sit down together to talk about where multicloud is actually heading: the workloads now moving across clouds, the data and AI demands reshaping architecture, and the customer expectations forcing providers who compete everywhere else to interoperate here. Expect candor about what’s working, what’s still hard, and what’s coming that could make or break an IT strategy. A rare chance to see four clouds share one stage — and a clear-eyed look at the trends shaping the next chapter of cross-cloud strategy.

sessions.title: OCI Storage with NetApp: Enterprise ONTAP Storage Natively Integrated with OCI
sessions.description: Learn how OCI Storage with NetApp brings enterprise ONTAP storage services into Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. This session shows how organizations can move Oracle databases, VMware, EDA/HPC, and other NetApp-dependent workloads to OCI while reducing the need to redesign shared storage or day-2 operations. We’ll cover topics such as multiprotocol access, snapshots, cloning, replication, backup, restore, immutability, hybrid continuity, and tiering economics for the workloads mentioned above.

sessions.title: Mission-Ready Cloud: Accelerating Federal Outcomes with OCI
sessions.description: Learn how federal organizations are leveraging Oracle Cloud Infrastructure to improve performance, strengthen resilience, support AI workloads, and maintain rigorous security requirements.

sessions.title: How HR Leaders Turn Workforce Signals into Better Decisions
sessions.description: Hear how HR and People leaders are using Fusion Data Intelligence to support workforce decisions. From hiring and retention to compensation and performance, panelists will share why they selected Fusion Data Intelligence, how they approached implementation, and how enterprise intelligence is helping inform workforce decisions. Learn where they initially saw value, how they approached organizational adoption, and the lessons they would share with teams beginning their own transformation.

sessions.title: Oracle AI Data Platform Innovation: Unifying Data, Analytics, and Agents
sessions.description: This session provides an executive overview of Oracle AI Data Platform and how Oracle Autonomous AI Lakehouse, Fusion Data Intelligence, and Oracle Analytics Cloud work together to support cross-functional enterprise intelligence. See how organizations can bring together data from Fusion applications, Snowflake, Salesforce, operational systems, and third-party sources to create data products with shared business semantics and consistent metrics that can support AI use cases. Learn how these data products can work with AI Registry and Agent Hub to support business-user experiences. The session demonstrates how connected data, analytics, and agents can help users turn insights into business actions.

sessions.title: Co-Innovating and Driving Success on Oracle Cloud and AI
sessions.description: Organizations are looking to move beyond AI experimentation and apply AI to support meaningful business outcomes. Join Oracle's customer success officer and executive leaders from Avaloq, Cargo Expreso, and Lexington Health, as they share lessons from their AI journeys and discuss how they are working with Oracle to advance business priorities. Hear how Oracle Cloud and AI technologies, combined with industry expertise and co-innovation, can help organizations address complex business challenges, support AI adoption, and pursue ongoing business value. Gain practical perspectives on approaches these organizations are taking as they put AI to work across their businesses.

sessions.title: Transforming Manufacturing Enterprises for Competitive Advantage in the AI Era
sessions.description: What does successful business transformation look like in the age of AI? Join leading manufacturing, technology, and transportation executives as they share how they’re modernizing operations, accelerating innovation, and delivering measurable outcomes. This panel will dive into breaking down organizational silos, connecting enterprise data, modernizing core business processes, and empowering employees with AI. You will hear firsthand how organizations align stakeholders and leverage Oracle Cloud to improve decision making, productivity, resilience, and customer outcomes. Whether you're just starting or looking to scale AI across the enterprise, gain practical strategies to successfully scale AI and drive lasting competitive advantage.
sessions.audienceLevel: Advanced Long Term User Of Oracle

sessions.title: Oracle Analytics Cloud : A Foundation for Trusted AI
sessions.description: Analytics shouldn't stop at dashboards. Learn how Oracle Analytics Cloud serves as the business consumption layer for enterprise AI, enabling analysts to move from governed semantic models to natural-language exploration, AI-assisted authoring, automated insights, and intelligent agents that recommend next actions. See how Oracle AI Data Platform and Oracle Analytics Cloud work together to accelerate workbook, SQL, and pipeline creation with AI-assisted development while supporting governance, security, and human oversight across the analytics lifecycle.

sessions.title: Enterprise Intelligence: The Missing Foundation for Enterprise AI
sessions.description: Generative AI has made it easier than ever to build AI agents, yet many organizations struggle to scale AI because enterprise information remains fragmented across ERP systems, documents, manufacturing applications, and business processes. Hear Yageo Group share lessons learned from implementing AI-driven document automation and integrating enterprise data into AI workflows. Building on these insights, Trinamix will introduce the Enterprise Intelligence architecture behind UniVerse and show how it supports AI agent development on OCI by connecting enterprise systems, harmonizing business semantics and enabling AI to reason with trusted business context. Discover scalable foundation for enterprise automation and operational insights.
sessions.audienceLevel: Advanced Long Term User Of Oracle

sessions.title: AI Without GPUs: Scale AI Inference with OCI Cloud Native and CPU Shapes
sessions.description: Companies that were early adopters of AI are now focused on reducing the cost of delivering AI outcomes. This session examines the end-to-end lifecycle of an inference request and shows how to optimize each step to lower overall cost and improve resilience. Explore how OCI cloud native services and CPU shapes support AI inference, alongside techniques such as model routing, workload qualification, and strategic CPU-versus-GPU deployment to improve the return on investment (ROI) of AI solutions.

sessions.title: Achieving AI-Ready Enterprise: OCI X12 and Intel Xeon 6 Processors
sessions.description: OCI and its hardware partners are advancing together to shape the future of cloud compute. Join this session to hear from Oracle and Intel leaders as they share how joint innovation on OCI compute infrastructure is unlocking new levels of performance, efficiency, and operational simplicity for customers. We will explore how organizations across industries are using the latest Xeon 6 based OCI instances to modernize their estates, run demanding enterprise workloads, and prepare for the AI era. We will also highlight recent milestones in the partnership and offer a glimpse of what is on the horizon, all focused on helping you get more value from your OCI compute infrastructure.

sessions.title: How JLL Turned an IT Decision into a Win for Tax and Finance
sessions.description: When JLL's IT team partnered with Tax and Finance to adopt a global compliance solution that seamlessly integrated with their ERP, the payoff went well beyond IT. See how Thomson Reuters ONESOURCE cut workload more than 60%, month-end reporting from three days to one, and ongoing maintenance for IT. Hear how going all-in on one platform freed every downstream team, why one data model across tax and e-invoicing matters for IT and finance alike, and where Fiduciary-Grade AI is taking them next. Whether you're leading a financial transformation, running global tax operations, or aligning IT and finance on compliance risk, you'll leave with a concrete picture of what "good" looks like, grounded in a customer who's lived it.

sessions.title: How Oracle Cloud Customers Beat AI Adoption Challenges to Deliver Business Value
sessions.description: Oracle Cloud customers are eager to adopt AI, but many encounter challenges long before realizing business value. Through real customer case studies, this panel explores the technical, organizational, and governance barriers that can slow adoption, including security concerns, integration complexity, data readiness, business resistance, and competing priorities. Hear how customers identified the proper AI opportunities, built stakeholder support, addressed risk and compliance requirements, and overcame implementation obstacles. Attendees will gain practical lessons and proven strategies to help accelerate AI adoption while balancing innovation, governance, and measurable business outcomes.

sessions.title: A playbook to intelligent, audit-ready operations – Lessons from DIRECTV
sessions.description: Customer expectations do not pause for transformation. As DIRECTV advances its separation from AT&T, the company is reimagining how fulfillment and logistics operations support growth, customer experience, and operational agility. Working with IBM and Oracle, DIRECTV is building a connected digital foundation that unifies fulfillment and logistics processes, increases visibility across forward and reverse logistics, and reduces operational complexity. Join DIRECTV and IBM to learn how modernizing supply chain operations can improve customer outcomes, increase agility, and create a scalable foundation for future AI-powered innovation.

sessions.title: Oracle AI DB Everywhere: From Multicloud Complexity to an AI-Ready Data Estate
sessions.description: As enterprises adopt AI, the question isn't "which cloud should my Oracle Database run on?" but "how do I make my data secure and AI-ready wherever my applications run?" With Oracle AI Database now available across OCI, Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, and hybrid environments, you can bring mission-critical data closer to applications, analytics, and AI. But technology alone is not a strategy. We share a practical blueprint for turning a fragmented Oracle estate into an AI-ready, unified multicloud platform: assessing dependencies, placing each workload, migrating with lower risk, designing for sovereignty, and unifying security, governance, FinOps, and AIOps. We then look beyond migration to trusted data for AI, RAG, and agentic applications.

sessions.title: The Path to Enterprise Autonomy: Building the Next Generation of AI Agents
sessions.description: The enterprise vision for agents is this: agents that can move beyond simple assistants and single-point tasks towards a higher level of autonomy, where they can plan, act, coordinate, and complete complex enterprise workflows. But this higher level isn’t possible without the right enterprise foundation. Attend this session to learn how Oracle is helping customers advance toward greater agent autonomy with the enterprise foundations needed (such as durable workflow state, permissions, identity, and sandboxed execution) to keep agents grounded, secure, observable, and accountable.

sessions.title: Top 10 Network Architecture Decisions for Modern Cloud Applications
sessions.description: Every network architecture decision influences application performance, security, scalability, and operational complexity. Join Oracle networking product leaders as we explore the ten most important decisions architects face when designing on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), from connectivity and segmentation to resiliency and global scale. Learn the tradeoffs behind each choice, how those decisions impact your architecture as it evolves, and how OCI Networking continues to innovate to support modern cloud and AI workloads. Hear practical insights from Oracle experts and a customer who shares the architecture decisions that made the biggest difference.

sessions.title: Stop Overpaying for Kubernetes: Migrate to OKE and Optimize Costs
sessions.description: Optimizing cloud spend is not just an operational task. It starts with how environments are designed, how workloads are deployed, and how teams create visibility and accountability across usage. In this deep dive, learn how to apply FinOps principles to OCI environments by aligning workload requirements with the right deployment patterns and infrastructure choices. We’ll explore when to use Oracle Kubernetes Engine, OCI Container Instances, OCI Functions, and bare metal based on workload scale, performance needs, operational model, and cost profile. We’ll also review OCI cost options that can help customers balance flexibility, predictability, and efficiency.

sessions.title: Oracle AIDP: Transforming Legacy HR Data into an AI-Ready Asset
sessions.description: Honeywell transformed decades of HR data across nearly 20 legacy applications into a unified, AI-ready platform using Oracle AI Data Platform (AIDP), OCI Object Storage, Autonomous AI Lakehouse, and Oracle FDI. Working with LTM, Honeywell consolidated structured and unstructured data into a governed repository with centralized metadata, lineage, retention, and security controls. The initiative accelerated legacy application retirement, reduced costs, simplified compliance, and improved access to historical workforce data. This session showcases how Honeywell converted archival data into a strategic enterprise asset, enabling AI-driven insights, modern analytics, and smarter decision making.
sessions.audienceLevel: Advanced Long Term User Of Oracle

sessions.title: AI Agents on OKE: Scalable GPU Infrastructure and Secure Pod Sandboxing
sessions.description: AI workloads need high-performance, flexible infrastructure—and AI agents need a secure place to execute code. Learn how OKE supports demanding AI workloads with GPU operators for NVIDIA and AMD, resource allocation and sharing capabilities such as DRA/DRANET, MIG, MPS, and time-slicing.

sessions.title: NVIDIA, Oracle and OpenAI - Powering the Agentic AI Era
sessions.description: NVIDIA, Oracle and OpenAI are together redefining what’s possible in enterprise AI. This session explores how OCI Superclusters powered by NVIDIA accelerated computing give OpenAI’s frontier models, including Astra, the infrastructure to run reliably at enterprise scale, with Vera CPU on OCI powering OpenAI’s agentic sandbox workloads. We’ll also cover the broader full stack NVIDIA-Oracle partnership, including CUDA-accelerated vector search in Oracle AI Database, open-source Nemotron models, and more.

sessions.title: Build Multicloud AI Apps That Never Go Down with Globally Distributed Database
sessions.description: Modern AI applications demand continuous availability, low latency, global scale, and the flexibility to run wherever data resides. In this session, learn how Oracle Globally Distributed Database delivers a single logical database across OCI, multicloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments. Explore proven patterns for placing data closer to users, scaling high-volume transactional workloads, and combining operational data with AI Vector Search to support intelligent applications. Leave with practical architectural guidance for building resilient, globally distributed AI applications while preserving SQL compatibility, operational simplicity, and control over data placement.

sessions.title: Why Your Vector Query is Slow: Inside Look to Oracle Optimizer
sessions.description: Vector search is transforming how applications retrieve and reason over data, but delivering high-performance AI-powered retrieval requires much more than a new index type. The Oracle Optimizer continues to evolve, recognizing vector access paths, estimating costs, and generating execution plans that seamlessly combine vector similarity search with traditional relational operations. Designed for developers and database specialists, this session explores how Oracle AI Database extends its cost-based optimization framework to support vector indexes and hybrid AI workloads.

sessions.title: Peer Exchange: From Enterprise Data to AI-Powered Business Value
sessions.description: Join a candid, customer-led table discussion on moving from data and AI pilots to broader adoption and measurable value. In groups of 5–8, compare how peers are combining data from Oracle Fusion Applications, Fusion Data Intelligence, and other enterprise systems and data platforms with AI agents and semantic reasoning to support insights, decision making, and action. Guided prompts will cover high-value use cases, data and context readiness, evaluation, deployment barriers, business-user adoption, and demonstrating value. Come prepared to share one experience, one lesson, and one challenge. This is a peer exchange, not a presentation; customers at every stage are welcome.

sessions.title: From Blueprint to Breakthrough: Scaling AI into Business Value
sessions.description: What separates enterprises realizing AI value today from those still experimenting? Hear from J.P. Morgan and McDonald’s on how they are turning AI into results in finance, from invoice automation and agentic treasury to sharper forecasts, real-time financial insight, and faster decision making. See how Oracle AI Data Platform brings planning, ERP, and analytics data from Oracle, Microsoft Azure, and AWS into one governed foundation for AI, so teams can trust the data behind every decision. Walk away with practical lessons on choosing the right use cases, building governance, and scaling AI from pilot to enterprise impact, shared by Cognizant.

sessions.title: Building the Future of Finance: From Enterprise Transformation to Agentic AI
sessions.description: See how the American Heart Association, DHL, McDonald's and Accenture are building the foundation for an AI-enabled future. DHL is applying agentic AI to accounts payable to improve efficiency, strengthen controls, and increase touchless processing. The American Heart Association transformed finance and procurement on Oracle Cloud and is now extending that foundation with AI-enabled automation. McDonald's moved from 19 market independent operations onto a unified global operating model on the Oracle Fusion Cloud platform, replacing 17 ERP systems and laying the foundation for AI-enabled operations. Learn how these organizations are modernizing finance, driving business value, and preparing for enterprise AI.

sessions.title: Redefining Enterprise Apps for the Age of AI
sessions.description: When business conditions change, people still carry the burden of interpreting what happened and coordinating the response. Oracle Fusion Applications are changing that. They can monitor business activity, recognize meaningful changes, determine the best next step, and take action—all within the policies, approvals, and controls of an enterprise. See how innovations including Fusion Agentic Applications, Fusion Claw, and the no-code-to-pro-code capabilities of Fusion AI Agent Studio are helping turn business signals into action.
sessions.audienceLevel: Advanced Long Term User Of Oracle
deliveryTypes: In Person Livestream And On Demand

sessions.title: How Polk County Uses Oracle AI Success Navigator to Support Release Readiness
sessions.description: Polk County, Florida, uses Oracle AI Success Navigator to help evaluate quarterly cloud updates and identify changes relevant to its production environment. This approach allows the team to focus its review on changes with potential operational impact while supporting release planning and collaboration with its managed services provider. Learn how AI-assisted tools can help public-sector IT teams manage cloud-update planning, support decision making, and prepare for continuous innovation.

sessions.title: Turning Fusion Operational Signals into Enterprise Action
sessions.description: Enterprises often struggle to turn operational signals into coordinated action across business functions. This session explores how Fusion Applications and Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI), together with Oracle AI Data Platform, enable a consistent approach to decision making and enterprise action. Across finance, supply chain, HR, and operations, organizations can connect industry and application data to detect emerging risks, understand downstream impacts, and coordinate responses across teams and systems. The session highlights a repeatable enterprise model in which customer-governed data, Fusion business context, and AI-driven agents help organizations move from insight to coordinated action at scale.

sessions.title: Cloud Transformation Starts with People: Lexington Health's ERP Journey
sessions.description: Lexington Health transformed its finance and supply chain operations by moving from Oracle PeopleSoft to Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, demonstrating how leadership, organizational change, and cloud modernization can deliver measurable business value. Working with Oracle, the organization reduced data conversion effort by 40%, cut expense report processing time by 85%, automated procure-to-pay and invoice processing, improved real-time reporting and decision making, and replaced paper-based processes while reducing reliance on customizations. Attendees will gain practical insights into executive sponsorship, change management, and building a modern cloud foundation that supports continuous innovation and future AI readiness.

sessions.title: How Banco Pichincha Keeps Modernizing Finance for AI-Enabled Innovation
sessions.description: Banco Pichincha keeps modernizing its finance and procurement operations by consolidating processes on Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and Oracle Accounting Hub, alongside Oracle analytics capabilities. The implementation helped shorten financial close cycles and streamline manual work, while supporting regulatory reporting. The bank is expanding analytics, AI capabilities, and intelligent automation to help teams make faster decisions across the organization. Attendees will learn practical lessons for modernizing finance through cloud transformation and phased innovation.

sessions.title: Migration Demystified: See a Multicloud Migration Happen Live
sessions.description: Think moving Oracle to the cloud takes months? In this 15-minute live session, watch it happen in minutes. We’ll provision an Oracle AI Database@AWS, @Azure, or @Google Cloud target, migrate a small preselected workload using proven tooling, and show it running across clouds with full capabilities intact—same SQL, same tools, new address. The goal is simple: prove how fast and how uneventful a real migration can be, before you commit to the full hands-on lab. If you’re weighing a move, this is the fastest way to see what’s actually real.

sessions.title: How Getnet Unified Finance Across Nine Operations with Oracle EPM
sessions.description: Getnet worked to unify financial planning across nine operations in multiple countries and currencies using Oracle Fusion Cloud Enterprise Performance Management. The company standardized planning practices while preserving local autonomy and integrated planning to create a more consistent enterprise-wide financial view. The platform includes Intelligent Performance Management capabilities such as IPM Insights and Advanced Predictions, which can help surface anomalies and inform forecasts. In this session, Getnet will share lessons from its finance modernization journey, including its approach to planning efficiency and preparing for continued AI adoption.

sessions.title: Analytics for Healthcare Providers, Payers, and Research Institutes
sessions.description: This session showcases Oracle's comprehensive healthcare data intelligence solutions, spanning the entire healthcare ecosystem, including providers, payers, life sciences, and research institutions. We'll explore how these solutions can enhance care, optimize financial performance, streamline reconciliation efforts, connect care teams, enhance patient engagement, and leverage AI agents to automate routine tasks and identify high-risk patients across populations. We'll also highlight how advanced analytics and AI enable these solutions to analyze diverse data sources, accelerate insights, drive informed decision making, and support complex research across the healthcare ecosystem.

sessions.title: Autonomous Agents: Gemini on Oracle Databases with Model Context Protocol (MCP)
sessions.description: Custom Natural-Language-to-SQL solutions are notoriously complex to build, difficult to secure, and brittle in production. This fast-paced, live-demo session introduces a game-changing solution: the Oracle AI Database Agent for Gemini and the Remote MCP (Model Context Protocol) Server. We’ll demonstrate how to securely connect Gemini to your Oracle database with zero custom query-translation code. This walkthrough shows how Gemini safely interprets a user's natural language request, builds and executes the appropriate database queries, and returns secure, human-readable results. Learn how Gemini is revolutionizing daily DBA operations, moving teams past simple database maintenance to intelligent automation.

sessions.title: From Hours to Minutes: Accelerate Incident Response with OCI Observability AI
sessions.description: Learn how OCI Observability uses generative AI and AI agents to accelerate incident response by analyzing full-stack telemetry, connecting signals across systems, and surfacing the insights that matter most. Discover how these capabilities transform fragmented, manual troubleshooting into focused investigations—revealing likely causes, recommending next steps, and helping teams reach resolution in minutes rather than hours.

sessions.title: CSG and HCLTech Build AI-Ready Trade Compliance with Oracle GTM
sessions.description: Join CSG and HCLTech to learn how CSG is establishing Oracle Global Trade Management as a centralized export compliance platform across customer, product, quote-to-order, licensing and reporting processes. The session will share practical lessons on embedding restricted-party screening, product classification, license determination, restricted-country checks, and compliance holds into operational workflows. Hear how CSG is improving visibility through dashboards, reducing manual effort and order rework, strengthening audit readiness, and targeting 80% to 90% automated compliance coverage as a foundation for more intelligent, governed business operations.

sessions.title: Secure & Accelerate AI Applications on OCI with Cloudflare: From Edge to Origin
sessions.description: AI applications on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure share the same exposure: public APIs and model endpoints, training data in motion, and inference traffic that legacy security can't handle. As AI workloads scale on OCI, so does the attack surface. See how Cloudflare and OCI close the gap together. Cloudflare's global network sits in front of OCI-hosted AI apps—DDP protection, WAF, bot management, and AI Gateway—while the Bandwidth Alliance eliminates egress fees, making the architecture cost-neutral to run. Zero Trust secures developer and operator access to private OCI resources with no VPN and no public endpoint. Leave with a reference architecture, a clear egress cost model, and steps to deploy Zero Trust same day.

sessions.title: Lunch
The Economics of AI: Why Model Routing Matters
sessions.description: Every AI prompt has a cost. The trick is knowing when you do and don't need a powerful model. In this hands-on lab, you'll build a customer support assistant that automatically routes requests to the suitable model for the job, using lower-cost models for routine questions and advanced models for image analysis. You’ll ground responses in service manuals, connect to Oracle Autonomous AI Database using natural-language-to-SQL capabilities and Oracle Autonomous AI Database MCP Server, deploy a Streamlit chat application, and configure OCI AI Guardrails to help detect potential prompt-injection attempts. Leave with a working AI assistant and a practical pattern that can help manage AI costs while balancing response speed and answer quality.

sessions.description: Go from zero to a running Model Context Protocol server in this hands-on lab using OCI Container Instances. MCP is an open protocol that gives AI agents a consistent way to connect to external tools, services, and data sources. Instead of building one-off integrations for every agent or application, MCP provides a repeatable interface for exposing capabilities and context to AI systems. sessions.description: In this 90-minute hands-on lab you’ll migrate a live Oracle workload into the hyperscaler of your choice and prove it running with full capabilities intact. Working in your own environment, you’ll provision an Oracle Database@AWS, @Azure, or @Google Cloud target, move a workload using proven tooling—Zero Downtime Migration, Data Migration Service, GoldenGate, and Data Guard—and validate performance, security, and connectivity on the other side. You’ll handle the real decisions: method selection, dependency mapping, cutover, and rollback. The deep technical companion to the migration learning session: leave having completed a migration yourself, with a playbook for your own estate. BYO laptop; hands-on-keyboard throughout.

sessions.description: Purpose-built for business and functional users who want to leverage pre-packaged analytics with Fusion Data Intelligence. This guided lab puts you directly in Fusion Data Intelligence's self-service environment, where you'll create dashboards, build ad hoc analyses, and get hands-on with AI agents across finance, HR, supply chain, sales, and marketing. You'll learn how to surface insights using natural language instead of writing code for common analytics tasks. Leave with practical skills and the confidence to begin applying Fusion Data Intelligence capabilities across your business from day one.

sessions.title: Run Vector Search with GPU Acceleration Using Oracle AI Database and NVIDIA cuVS
sessions.description: In this hands-on lab, you will configure Oracle AI Database 26ai to offload index creation to NVIDIA GPUs using NVIDIA cuVS-powered Vector Index Service. You will load embeddings, build an HNSW vector index, compare GPU and CPU index-build performance, and execute semantic similarity searches using SQL. The lab demonstrates how organizations can accelerate the preparation of large vector datasets while keeping vectors, metadata, and business data governed within Oracle AI Database.

sessions.description: Embark on an exciting journey to build and deploy an agentic AI solution using the Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) AI Agent Framework. In this hands-on lab, you'll explore the power of creating intelligent agents that can revolutionize various industries. By the end of this lab, you'll have a solid understanding of building and customizing agentic AI solutions, opening up a world of possibilities for virtual assistants, customer support bots, and smart automation. Get ready to unleash your creativity and harness the power of OCI's AI services. "Participants must bring their own standard Windows or Mac laptop with at least 8GB of RAM, Chrome installed. Optional: Python3, Codex or other Coding Agent, VSCode."

sessions.title: Secure at Source with Deep Data Security
sessions.description: Agentic AI is changing how applications access enterprise data, increasing the risk of overprivileged access by both users and AI agents, and unintended data exposure. In this hands-on lab, you will build an application using Oracle Autonomous AI Database and see how an AI agent could expose sensitive data. You will then learn to implement Deep Data Security access controls at the data layer to help mitigate this risk by applying security at the source, where the data lives.

sessions.title: Your First Enterprise Agent Needs More Than a Prompt: Build It with Select AI
sessions.description: Discover how to create, configure, and test AI agents with Oracle Select AI Agent Framework in Autonomous AI Database. In this hands-on lab, create and refine agents and tools using PL/SQL and Python APIs and the Ask Oracle Select AI APEX app. Learn how Oracle Select AI Agent Framework is designed to help simplify agent development with multiturn conversations, context retention, and permission-based sharing across users, among other capabilities. You’ll build tools, tasks, and agents that help address common enterprise scenarios using Autonomous AI Database and the latest Oracle AI development tools.

sessions.title: Build Semantic Search with Images and Text in Oracle APEX
sessions.description: Build a semantic search application using Oracle AI Database and Oracle APEX. In this hands-on lab, you’ll use ONNX pipeline models, including CLIP, to build AI-driven searches that understand both image content and text meaning. You'll build and query a semantic search application, learn how to store and manage vector embeddings in the database, and use Oracle AI Vector Search to support relevant search experiences. By the end of the lab, you'll have a working application and a practical understanding of building vector search applications with Oracle AI Database and APEX.
