sessions.title: Beyond Go-Live: How Oracle Guided Learning and AI Unlock Adoption at Providence
sessions.description: Go-live is just the beginning. How do you keep users engaged as cloud and AI capabilities evolve? Discover how Providence uses Oracle Guided Learning to bring guidance into everyday work and help users discover AI tools, with active Oracle Guided Learning users growing approximately 3x since 2023. Walk away with practical lessons to support your users and sustain adoption beyond launch.

sessions.title: Building Agentic AI for Restaurant Operations
sessions.description: Restaurant operators need more than AI that surfaces insights or generates answers. They need intelligent systems that understand restaurant operations, focus teams on the highest-value issues, and help turn decisions into measurable improvements. This session explores Oracle’s approach to designing closed-loop agents for restaurant operations. Learn how operational data, restaurant context, secure system access, human approvals, and outcome measurement come together to support governed action across labor, inventory, digital ordering, loss prevention, and guest experience. Attendees will gain a practical view of where agentic AI can create value for restaurant operators and how Oracle is approaching the path from insight to action.

sessions.title: From Oracle E-Business Suite to Agentic AI: HBL's Transformation
sessions.description: HBL's HR transformation illustrates how a modern digital foundation can support enterprise AI adoption. After moving from Oracle E-Business Suite HRMS to Oracle Fusion HCM and expanding Oracle Redwood across the employee experience, HBL is now exploring the next phase of its AI journey with Oracle Fusion Agentic AI and OCI AI. Working with Oracle Customer Success Services, the organization has defined an AI roadmap focused on high-value HR use cases. Learn how HBL is connecting modernization, AI readiness, and business transformation to support continuous innovation.

sessions.title: How Beca Supports Cloud Innovation with Oracle AI Success Navigator
sessions.description: Beca is modernizing how it delivers cloud innovation by using Oracle AI Success Navigator to help streamline planning, evaluate new capabilities, and support adoption across its finance systems. By helping improve consistency and reduce the time and effort required to evaluate and implement cloud innovations, Success Navigator supports Beca's approach to continuous modernization and business value. Learn about Beca's journey and gain practical insights for supporting AI readiness and cloud innovation within your own organization.

sessions.title: How Avis Budget Group Is Operationalizing Agentic AI at Enterprise Scale
sessions.description: As organizations look beyond AI experimentation, Avis Budget Group is exploring what it takes to operationalize agentic AI at enterprise scale. By modernizing business processes with Oracle Fusion Applications and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, the company is implementing AI-enabled workflows with business controls and oversight to help streamline complex operations, improve efficiency, and support business growth. Attend this session to learn how Avis built an AI-ready foundation and is applying it across contract, finance, and back-office processes.

sessions.title: Digital Shopping Concierge: Discovery to Delight Powered by Oracle Enterprise AI
sessions.description: Every traveler has questions before making a purchase, but at one of the world's busiest airports, every minute matters. Discover how Dubai Duty Free transformed customer engagement by leveraging Oracle Enterprise AI to deliver a personalized digital shopping experience. Learn how Oracle Enterprise AI, OCI Generative AI Agents, Oracle Digital Assistant, Oracle Integration, Oracle Commerce, and Oracle Fusion Service enable intelligent product discovery, AI-powered recommendations, real-time availability, conversational ordering, order tracking, and customer service through a unified AI shopping concierge—delivering faster service, improved customer experience, and increased retail engagement.

sessions.title: Small Shifts, Big Wins: Optimizing AI Workloads for Financial Sustainability
sessions.description: AI is transforming how teams operate, but the workloads powering it are among the most expensive and unpredictable to run. AI workloads can rely on external APIs, managed cloud services, dedicated GPU infrastructure, and Kubernetes environments—each with distinct billing models and cost drivers. The challenge: understanding cost drivers and how to use resources more efficiently. In this session, we’ll share real-world examples of how IBM Cloudability is helping teams understand how these costs are billed in OCI and where savings may be hiding, with a closer look at OKE. Learn how to improve GPU utilization, forecast spend, implement chargeback, and track unit cost metrics for scalable and financially sustainable AI workloads.

sessions.title: Stop Overprovisioning: Optimize Memory Across OCI Compute
sessions.description: Many enterprise workloads are constrained more by memory than CPU capacity. In this short hub session, learn how OCI's dynamic resource virtualization capabilities can help optimize memory utilization across compute instances, better align infrastructure with application requirements, help reduce overprovisioning, and improve workload efficiency. Discover where memory optimization can deliver value for enterprise applications, modernization initiatives, AI inference and supporting services, and how to incorporate memory optimization into a broader OCI compute optimization strategy.

sessions.title: From AI Strategy to Scalable Value: Reinventing Transformation Delivery
sessions.description: The next wave of business transformation enabled by Oracle is not about adding more AI. It is about embedding intelligence into how transformation is delivered. Fujitsu's CloudScale framework integrates AI-powered capabilities across planning, design, testing, governance, and operations to accelerate implementations, improve quality, reduce costs, and speed time-to-value. Through a real-world customer success story with World Wide Technology (WWT), attendees will see how Fujitsu applied intelligent automation to transform a manual process into a scalable business capability that delivers measurable value and supports continuous innovation.

sessions.title: AI at Full Sail: Transforming Performance and Media at SailGP
sessions.description: Join Melissa Lawton, chief content officer at SailGP, to discover how AI and Oracle technology turn the speed and complexity of racing on water into a thrilling live experience. ​ Explore how OCI, FastConnect (Live Line), Streaming, Stream Analytics, and Autonomous Data Warehouse transform live F50 telemetry into performance insights, comparisons, and visualizations for teams, broadcast partners, and fans.​ See how AI reveals the moments that matter, adding timely context and compelling storytelling that make the action easier to follow and bring audiences closer to the athletes, technology, and drama on the water.​

sessions.title: Enterprise AI Deep Dive: Building Trusted, Differentiated Solutions with Oracle
sessions.description: Enterprise AI remains a jagged frontier, yet Oracle is a steady, trusted partner for navigating what comes next. This session will show partners where Oracle is investing and where they can build differentiated products. Oracle leaders will present product walkthroughs and reference campaigns and share examples of how partners have combined their domain expertise with Oracle technology. Partners will leave with a clear view of the product surfaces they can extend, the available deployment models, and the requirements for taking a joint solution into production.

sessions.title: Beyond Profitability: Agentic AI for Intelligent Banking Decisions
sessions.description: Banks have long relied on profitability, transfer pricing, and balance sheet analytics to guide strategic decisions. Today, agentic AI is transforming these capabilities into proactive, intelligent decision support. In this session, learn how leading institutions are combining profitability insights and AI-generated recommendations to better understand performance, optimize capital allocation, and respond faster to market change. Through customer success stories and practical use cases, discover how AI is helping banks move beyond retrospective reporting toward real-time, forward-looking decisions that improve resilience, accelerate growth, and create competitive advantage while maintaining transparency and governance.

sessions.title: Map, Analyze, and Optimize OCI Environments with Resource Analytics
sessions.description: As OCI environments expand across regions, tenancies, applications, and teams, troubleshooting slows, automation becomes harder, risk increases, and waste becomes harder to see. OCI Resource Analytics provides a near-real-time view of resources, relationships, and configuration metadata across OCI. In this session, learn how teams can use that visibility to assess the impact of critical updates, map dependencies before changes, help improve automation, identify governance gaps, and uncover resources such as volumes without backups. See how OCI Resource Analytics helps turn cloud inventory into operational intelligence to support faster decisions, safer changes, and more efficient cloud operations.

sessions.title: Deploy Anywhere, Compromise Nowhere: How OCI Fits Hyperscale into Three Racks
sessions.description: Private cloud has always come with three assumed tradeoffs: higher cost, fewer services, and a different experience from public cloud. This session challenges all three. Oracle Dedicated Cloud starts at just three racks and delivers 200+ fully managed cloud services, the same APIs, and the same developer tooling as public OCI, with no on-premises premium and no operational burden passed to the team.

sessions.title: From Project Truth to Enterprise Outcomes: Connected AI for Capital Projects
sessions.description: Capital projects are enterprise investments, but many organizations still manage planning, finance, procurement, delivery, and operations through disconnected systems. This session shows how Oracle helps connect capital construction management data into trusted project truth, transform it into enterprise intelligence, and create a stronger foundation for embedded AI. Attendees will also hear directly from customers in a panel discussion about how they are approaching connected project and enterprise data, improving decision confidence, and preparing their organizations for more intelligent capital project management.

sessions.title: Best Practices for Getting More Value from Oracle Cloud HCM
sessions.description: You've built a strong foundation, but how can you get more value from your HCM investment? Hear how experienced Cloud HCM customers have operationalized continuous innovation to improve business outcomes. Panelists will share how they uncover new opportunities for value, prioritize high-impact capabilities, increase adoption, and connect ongoing innovation to measurable results. Learn practical ways to maximize your Oracle Cloud HCM investment and prepare your workforce for the next wave of AI-enabled change. ​

sessions.title: Accelerating AI Automation with Governance, Compliance, and Control
sessions.description: Organizations are rapidly investing in AI and automation to improve efficiency, decision making, and business outcomes. But successful adoption requires more than technology. Governance, compliance, and risk management are the foundation for responsible, secure, and scalable AI-powered automation. As automation expands into critical processes, organizations must embed contractual, regulatory, data, and operational controls throughout the lifecycle. This session explores how governance-first strategies reduce risk, build trust, and support innovation. Attendees will learn how to integrate compliance into workflows, manage AI risks, and align legal, compliance, business, and technology teams.

sessions.title: Inside Fusion Data Intelligence's AI-Powered Analytics Platform
sessions.description: Organizations need both speed and flexibility from their analytics platforms. Fusion Data Intelligence provides capabilities designed to support both. This session delivers a comprehensive technical and strategic walkthrough of Fusion Data Intelligence—from ingestion to insight—covering automated data pipelines with built-in observability, a consistent semantic layer, AI-powered analytics, and an extensible architecture that supports custom metrics, supported third-party data sources, and evolving enterprise analytics requirements.

sessions.title: Unify Enterprise Context and Data across your Oracle estate and 3rd Parties
sessions.description: Modern enterprises need data that can support AI use cases while managing the complexity of data movement across platforms. This technical session explores how Oracle AI Data Platform supports data engineering approaches designed to reduce unnecessary data movement and transformation. See how organizations can bring together Fusion Applications data and external operational sources while supporting consistent business context. Explore data products that can support analytics, AI applications, and intelligent agents, along with open table formats, external catalogs, and modern data engineering workflows designed for enterprise AI use cases.

sessions.title: Oracle Fusion Cloud Project Management: Strategy and Innovation Roadmap
sessions.description: Project-driven organizations need a connected foundation that helps teams plan, execute, forecast, and control work with greater speed and accuracy, not just manage individual project tasks. Join this session to learn Oracle’s strategy and innovation roadmap for Oracle Fusion Cloud Project Management, including how AI agents and agentic applications are shaping the future of project-based work. Discover upcoming investments designed to improve project outcomes while addressing the unique needs of services, construction, engineering, public sector, and other project-driven industries.
sessions.audienceLevel: Advanced Long Term User Of Oracle

sessions.title: How You Move is More Important Than When You Move: Legacy ERP to Oracle Fusion
sessions.description: For most organizations, whether to move to Oracle Fusion Cloud has been settled. Execution is what remains. Using real customer migrations as evidence, we walk through the decisions between vendor selection and go-live, and the operating posture six to eighteen months after cutover, where Fusion risk actually sits. We cover what gets sequenced first, what to lift, rebuild, or retire, why organizations get this three-way split backwards on the modules they know least well, and how audit, identity, and observability get carried through the cutover intact. Aimed at CIOs, program leaders, and technical directors, attendees leave with a framework, a pre-cutover decision checklist, and language to make the internal case for change discipline.

sessions.title: A Seamless Healthcare Journey, Powered by One Oracle
sessions.description: In this session, follow a fictional oncology patient’s journey to see how connected healthcare can reduce friction from diagnosis through treatment, clinical trials, payer coordination, and follow-up. Oracle brings together data and workflows across providers, payers, life sciences, research, genomics, supply chain, and analytics—helping care teams make more informed, personalized decisions while reducing administrative burden. Although the story centers on oncology, the vision applies to every patient: a healthcare ecosystem that works as one.

sessions.title: FDI Implementation Lessons Across Finance, HR, and Supply Chain
sessions.description: This practitioner clinic explores three real-world Fusion Data Intelligence implementations across Finance, HR, and Supply Chain. Using a common framework, customers and delivery leaders will share design decisions that helped them realize value, assumptions they revisited, and tradeoffs they made along the way. Explore practical patterns for extending Fusion Data Intelligence, integrating third-party data, managing shared metrics, and preparing for agentic capabilities. Leave with implementation lessons and deployment considerations you can apply to your own journey.

sessions.title: SCM Product Strategy and Roadmap: The Autonomous Supply Chain
sessions.description: Drive your supply chain into a new era of resilience, agility, and execution excellence. Join us to see how Oracle’s Agentic AI Applications help transform supply chain operations across planning, manufacturing, logistics, procurement, and order fulfillment. Learn how AI agents help reduce information overload, automate routine decisions, and streamline workflows, enabling planners, operators, and supply chain teams to respond faster to disruptions, optimize inventory and capacity, improve service levels, and accelerate execution. Discover how intelligent automation and industry-driven innovation are augmenting human expertise to support more accurate planning, efficient operations, and improved supply chain performance.

sessions.title: How Leading Organizations Run Production AI/ML Workloads at Scale on OKE
sessions.description: AI teams need infrastructure that can move from experimentation to production w/o sacrificing performance, scalability, security, or cost control. In this session, learn why Oracle Kubernetes Engine is a strong foundation for running AI/ML workloads on OCI, from model development and large-scale training to serving and inference. We’ll cover how OKE helps teams use GPUs, bare metal, flexible compute, RDMA networking, storage, observability, & automation to build production-ready AI platforms with Kubernetes. You’ll also hear real-world lessons from an Oracle customer using OKE to support demanding AI/ML workloads, including practical considerations for architecture, operations, & scaling.

sessions.title: From ERP-Centric Enterprise to AI-Orchestrated Enterprise: A New Paradigm Shift
sessions.description: For decades, ERP systems have powered enterprise operations across finance, procurement, supply chain, manufacturing, HR, and service. However, complex customizations and rigid architectures often limit agility. This session explores the shift to AI-orchestrated enterprises, where ERP remains the trusted system of record while AI drives intelligence, automation, and decisions. Featuring insights from a leading Canadian communications, sports, and entertainment company, discover how thin-core ERP strategies, governed AI agents, enterprise data products, and orchestration frameworks modernize operations. Learn how connected layers of record, process, intelligence, integration, and experience enable agile, intelligent enterprises.

sessions.title: Creating What's Next: Foundations for Growth and Innovation
sessions.description: Every transformation journey begins with a strong foundation. Join leaders from Watlow, MARTA and Southern Company as they share how they are leveraging Oracle Fusion and AI to modernize operations, improve agility, and create a platform for future growth. Each organization brings a unique perspective, from strengthening inventory visibility, planning, and operational efficiency through intelligent automation to transforming enterprise processes to drive user adoption, smarter decision making, and better business outcomes. Through these real-world journeys, discover how a strong digital core, intelligent automation, and a focus on business value are helping organizations drive innovation, operational excellence, and long-term growth.

sessions.title: Agents in Action: How KPMG Deploys Fusion Agentic Apps at Scale
sessions.description: Organizations are moving beyond AI experimentation and seeking practical ways to drive measurable business value. Join KPMG and Oracle for a real-world look at how KPMG helps clients identify high-value use cases, design and deploy custom and partner agents using Oracle AI Agent Studio, and establish governance to manage them at scale. Through client engagement and industry-relevant examples, learn how organizations can accelerate adoption, build trust, and achieve meaningful outcomes with agentic AI. The session concludes with a special presentation from Republic Services, the winner of the 2026 KPMG Hackathon, showcasing an innovative new agent concept and the future of enterprise AI.

sessions.title: Stop Overthinking Deployment: Ship Serverless with OCI Functions
sessions.description: Learn how to choose the right deployment model for each workload: bring a containerized function when they need control over the runtime, dependencies, and packaging, or use code-only functions when they want a faster, simpler path from application logic to running serverless service.
sessions.audienceLevel: Advanced Long Term User Of Oracle

sessions.title: Oracle HCM AI Agents: Transforming the Employee Experience
sessions.description: How are leading organizations reimagining the employee experience with AI? Join this panel discussion to explore how Oracle HCM AI Agents are helping enterprises simplify HR interactions, improve self-service, and enhance workforce productivity across Talent Acquisition, Core HR, Absence Management, and Compensation. As organizations accelerate AI adoption, success depends on balancing innovation with governance, security, and responsible AI practices. Hear insights from industry leaders on their AI transformation journeys, implementation lessons, and approaches to driving business value. The session will also explore emerging innovations shaping the future of intelligent work experiences.

sessions.title: Modernizing Ahead of ERP: HDR's Journey to a Future-Ready Tax Foundation
sessions.description: HDR is leveraging tax modernization as an early step in its Oracle Cloud ERP journey. When a technology change from its incumbent provider created a strategic decision point, HDR chose to modernize its Edge technologies, including tax, ahead of ERP. In this session, learn how HDR completed an eight-month global AR and AP transformation on Oracle E-Business Suite while preparing for the future. Attendees will gain insights into how HDR built a cloud-ready tax foundation, reduced Fusion migration risk, avoided an interim solution, and preserved continuity across tax processes, integrations, and institutional knowledge.

sessions.title: AI-Ready Foundations: OCI Modernization and Enterprise Scale
sessions.description: Organizations cannot scale AI without a modern, resilient digital foundation. This session explores how, in partnership with Accenture, leading organizations are using OCI modernization, data platforms, and enterprise architecture to create the performance, scalability, and flexibility required for AI-driven reinvention. Join us to learn how organizations are strengthening data, cloud, and operational foundations to improve decision making, increase workforce efficiency, and prepare for the growing use of AI. Hear how ICU Medical and Southern Company are building the digital foundations needed to accelerate AI innovation through large-scale Oracle-powered transformation programs.

sessions.title: Mission-Critical Modernization with Oracle Database@AnyCloud
sessions.description: Modernizing a core platform is never just an IT project. It is a race against risk, regulation, and time, with business continuity on the line. Moderated by Cognizant, this panel brings together Talcott Financial Group, Citizens Bank, and Microsoft’s multicloud strategy lead to share how critical databases moved to a multicloud foundation with Oracle Database@AnyCloud. Talcott modernized more than 50 mission-critical databases and built a secure, audit-ready foundation. Key takeaways: how to plan cutovers without disrupting the business, build governance regulators can trust, choose the right multicloud approach, and prepare data platforms for AI.

sessions.title: VMware + OCI: AI World of Possibilities
sessions.description: Oracle Cloud VMware Solution (OCVS) enables organizations to run VMware workloads on OCI while preserving familiar VMware tools, processes, and operational models. The session will provide an overview of OCVS, including supported compute shapes, highlight the latest capabilities, including Bring Your Own License (BYOL), VMware Cloud Foundation 9.1, and new compute shapes. Learn how OCVS integrates w/OCI services to extend and enhance their VMware environments. The session will conclude by exploring how customers can evolve their cloud strategy at their own pace—continuing to run and enhance VMware workloads on OCVS while also taking advantage of OCI cloud-native services where they align with their business and application needs.

sessions.title: Let Coding Agents Talk to the Database: Faster Development with MCP
sessions.description: Discover how Oracle development teams and MineSense are using OCI Database Tools MCP Servers to connect AI coding agents directly to Oracle AI Database, helping accelerate software development. See how MCP provides context-aware access to database metadata, performance insights, and operational data to help speed debugging, optimize SQL, and streamline code changes. The session includes a product roadmap, a live demo, and a customer case study highlighting developer productivity improvements and lessons learned.

sessions.title: Inside Oracle’s AI-Assisted Approach to Database Software Security
sessions.description: How is Oracle using AI to strengthen database software security? Go inside an engineering approach that combines frontier AI models, deep database expertise and established security testing to find issues and deliver validated fixes. Explore how this work also improves product quality and supports timely protection across cloud and on-premises environments, including Autonomous AI Database. Learn what this means for customers keeping protection current while assessing application impacts and minimizing disruption.

sessions.title: Customer Panel: From Automation to Autonomy with Oracle Autonomous AI Database
sessions.description: Hear from senior technology leaders as they share how their organizations are advancing from automation to autonomy with Oracle Autonomous AI Database. Through brief presentations, each customer panelist will highlight practical lessons, business outcomes, and challenges from their transformation journey. A moderated discussion will explore common themes, contrasting approaches, and strategies for architecture, governance, risk, skills, and organizational change. The session will conclude with audience Q&A, providing an opportunity to learn directly from customer experiences and peer insights.

sessions.title: Building a Data Fabric with GoldenGate, an AI Truth Layer for Data
sessions.description: The value of applications, analytics, and AI depends in part on access to current data. Discover how Oracle GoldenGate can support a multicloud Data Fabric, helping organizations connect distributed data sources and move data as it changes across supported hybrid and multicloud environments. Explore the capabilities and architecture behind this approach. See how Oracle GoldenGate can help simplify access to timely data for operational systems, modern analytics, and AI-enabled experiences. Through product insights and demonstrations, learn how continuously changing enterprise data can support a connected data foundation for timely, informed decision making and action.

sessions.title: Ask Your Database Anything: Generative AI with Select AI and OCI
sessions.description: Generative AI is transforming how organizations interact with enterprise data. Instead of relying solely on SQL or predefined dashboards, users can ask questions in natural language and receive insights based on enterprise data. This session explores how developers and architects can build conversational data applications using Oracle Autonomous AI Database Select AI, and OCI Generative AI. Learn how Select AI translates natural language questions into SQL, integrates enterprise data with large language models, and supports retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to generate, context-aware responses grounded in structured data.

sessions.title: AppGen: Meet Oracle's AI App Development Platform
sessions.description: Ready to move beyond AI app demos? Join this peer-to-peer session at Oracle AI World to try Oracle’s AI app development and deployment platform firsthand. Bring an application idea, add connectors to OCI services and Oracle Databases, and see AI turn a natural-language prompt into a deployed secure, trusted, and scalable full-stack enterprise app. Explore the generated React and Node.js code, test key workflows, and share candid feedback on the experience. You will also experience realistic sample enterprise apps that have been pre-built and deployed on AppGen. Your input will help shape the product—and participants who complete the session and provide feedback will receive Oracle swag as a thank-you.

sessions.title: The Agentic Enterprise: Transforming Systems of Record into Systems of Action
sessions.description: Decades of valuable enterprise data often remain trapped in on-premises databases due to the high costs, time, and risks of migrating it to AI models. Oracle AI Database @Google Cloud solves this by bringing Google's frontier AI directly to your data without complex re-architecting. Join this executive panel to hear business leaders share how they migrated mission-critical Oracle workloads natively into Google Cloud. Discover how they use Gemini to turn static systems of record into real-time, autonomous workflows while de-risking cloud strategies. The session also covers the latest Google Cloud and Oracle announcements.

sessions.title: Delta Takes Flight: Faster to Cloud with Oracle Database@AWS
sessions.description: Mission-critical systems leave little room for downtime, yet many organizations assume cloud modernization requires years of costly, high-risk application rewrites. Delta Air Lines' rapid transformation challenged that assumption. As part of its cloud strategy, Delta worked with Oracle, AWS, and Deloitte to migrate a critical resilience platform to Oracle Database@AWS without rebuilding the core applications that power its business. In this session, leaders from Delta, Oracle, AWS, and Deloitte will share the business drivers, architectural decisions, and multicloud strategy behind the transformation. Learn how Delta helped accelerate modernization, enhanced resiliency, improved performance, and optimized costs while minimizing disruption.

sessions.title: APi Group Takes Estimate to Invoice and Turns Field Service into a Profit Center
sessions.description: After its go-live with Oracle Fusion, APi Group is moving from implementation to broader adoption, connecting service, field service, finance, and revenue processes from opportunity to invoice on a unified platform. In this session, APi Group will share what went well, what it is refining, and what comes next as the organization continues to scale. The discussion will also explore why trusted data matters for AI and how APi Group is thinking about connecting people, processes, and data to help support intelligent automation and customer and employee experiences across the business.

sessions.title: Roadmap to Growing Revenue Beyond the First Sale: New Agentic Growth Strategy
sessions.description: Revenue growth increasingly depends on how well marketing, sales, customer success, and revenue teams coordinate around the full customer lifecycle. This session introduces Oracle’s Agentic Growth vision: using enterprise customer signals to identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities, surface renewal risk earlier, recommend the right growth motion, and coordinate marketing and sales action before opportunities are missed or renewals become save motions. Attendees will learn how agentic growth can help marketing teams move from broad campaign activity to signal-driven programs, while helping sellers focus on higher-fit accounts, better-timed outreach, and customer conversations with more context.

sessions.title: Supporting Oracle Cloud Adoption with Oracle Guided Learning and AI
sessions.description: As a newly established regulated utility, Delta Utilities deployed multiple Oracle Utilities Cloud applications while developing new business processes. Learn how the team uses Oracle Guided Learning and AI-assisted capabilities to support user adoption, content creation, and in-application guidance across Oracle Cloud applications. Hear practical lessons on developing an Oracle Guided Learning program, using AI-assisted tools with human review, and supporting ongoing business change and user enablement.

sessions.title: Building a Foundation for AI: The World Bank Modernization Journey
sessions.description: Join the World Bank to learn how it is using Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and Oracle Customer Success Services to modernize core technology environments and support ongoing transformation. Explore how Service Level Objectives (SLOs) can help align technology performance objectives with business priorities and how Oracle AI Data Platform and OCI Lakehouse capabilities can help establish a scalable data foundation for analytics and potential AI use cases. Attendees will gain practical approaches to modernization, supporting operational agility, and preparing for future AI initiatives.

sessions.title: How Asure Automated Payroll Tax for Oracle Cloud HCM
sessions.description: Managing payroll tax compliance across multiple states, jurisdictions, and regulatory environments presents significant challenges for organizations of all sizes. This session explores how organizations can modernize payroll tax operations by replacing manual, error-prone processes with automated, accurate, and audit-ready solutions. Learn how real-time integrations, automated multijurisdiction filing and deposits and continuously updated compliance technology can reduce administrative overhead, improve filing accuracy, and minimize compliance risk. Attendees will leave with practical strategies for simplifying payroll tax compliance, improving operational efficiency, and freeing payroll teams to focus on higher-value strategic initiatives.

sessions.title: First Look: Put Enterprise Data to Work on OCI with NetApp
sessions.description: Be among the first to learn about OCI Storage with NetApp and how it enables customers to run their most demanding workloads on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. As organizations move AI, databases, analytics, VMware, and other data-intensive applications to OCI, storage and data management requirements can create friction and slow adoption. We'll show how OCI Storage with NetApp removes those barriers with enterprise-grade data services natively integrated into OCI, enabling seamless modernization while preserving familiar data management workflows. Learn where the service fits within the OCI ecosystem and explore real-world use cases across AI, Oracle databases, VMware, analytics, EDA, and other data-intensive environments.

sessions.title: Scaling Without the Sprawl: Consolidating Payroll with Oracle and Deel
sessions.description: Expansion, restructuring, acquisition, transformation. Enterprises are rarely standing still, and payroll is often where the strain shows. Running a dozen or more local providers, in-country partners, and aggregators, each with separate contracts, reporting, and compliance posture, leaves fragmented visibility, unpredictable TCO, and audit exposure. This session shows how Oracle and Deel close that gap. Oracle Fusion HCM stays the system of record while Deel provides local payroll, entities, and expertise across more than 150 countries, covering every employment model from contingent to direct employment. Through real-world use cases, we'll explore how teams running both consolidate vendors and keep one clear view of their global workforce.

sessions.title: Building the Foundation for AI-Powered Finance at Cleveland Clinic
sessions.description: Cleveland Clinic is modernizing finance operations to build a stronger foundation for future AI adoption. Through Oracle Cloud ERP modernization, process standardization, workflow automation, governance improvements, supplier enablement, and data readiness initiatives, the organization is addressing complex manual processes, disconnected workflows, and inconsistent data structures while helping improve operational efficiency. Hear lessons from Cleveland Clinic’s transformation, including how simplifying processes, improving data quality, strengthening integration, and managing organizational change can help finance leaders build the operational and technology foundation to evaluate and adopt emerging AI capabilities.

sessions.title: Fusion Claw Unplugged: Ask the Experts
sessions.description: You just heard the announcement about Fusion Claw—now get your questions answered. Join the experts shaping its architecture and experiences for an interactive conversation about what Fusion Claw is, how it works, and what it makes possible. Explore how Fusion Claw combines AI reasoning with deterministic enterprise computation to take on harder, higher-value planning and execution—all within enterprise-defined authority. Bring your questions, compare perspectives with peers, and dig into the use cases, architecture, governance, and possibilities for increasingly autonomous enterprise operations.

sessions.title: AI Innovation: OCI is Building Secure Multicloud Enterprises
sessions.description: AI success accelerates with a secure and scalable cloud foundation. Explore with us, how enterprises are transforming their technology estates by migrating Oracle and non-Oracle workloads to OCI and modernizing mission-critical applications across their businesses. Learn how OCI and Google Cloud together, are helping organizations accelerate AI innovation, increase operational efficiency, strengthen governance and security, and unlock valuable business insights. Gain strategic and technical guidance from the practical transformation experiences and proven modernization approaches, on building resilient multi-cloud architectures.

sessions.title: From Vision to Value at AI Speed
sessions.description: The era of AI experimentation is over—the race to scale is on. But scaling AI is not just a technology challenge; it is a human one. This session explores how technology and business leaders can work toward translating AI ambition into measurable outcomes while helping people adapt and participate. We’ll consider why some organizations may be progressing faster than others, how AI-native operating models could evolve, and what leaders might consider when moving agentic AI from pilot to production. We’ll explore how architecture, governance, talent, and trust can work together to redesign work, strengthen adoption, and help AI complement human judgment.

sessions.title: AI Can Build It, But Can You Trust It? Data Is the Key
sessions.description: AI can now build solutions in minutes. But how can enterprises trust them? AI guardrails aren’t enough. We need a fundamentally different approach. Join Juan to discover how Oracle AI Database’s Deep-Trust AI Architecture enables you to accelerate AI innovation and insights, while ensuring that security, accuracy, and governance are not bypassed or compromised.

sessions.title: Achieving Workforce Excellence Through Intelligent Compliance Automation
sessions.description: Organizations in highly regulated industries, including healthcare, manufacturing, retail, and financial services, must balance productivity with labor laws, certification requirements, safety standards, and compliance mandates. Modern workforce management solutions use configurable rules engines, intelligent automation, and real-time insights to embed compliance into daily operations. By standardizing policies, automating decisions, and proactively identifying risks, organizations can improve scheduling accuracy, optimize labor utilization, reduce compliance exposure, and increase agility. Learn how rules-driven workforce management simplifies complexity, supports compliance, adapts to changing regulations, and improves business outcomes.

sessions.title: Oracle at Oracle: How Oracle Turns Strategy into Revenue Execution with AI
sessions.description: Hear how Oracle transformed its own revenue operating model by connecting marketing, sales, revenue operations, and agentic applications around shared revenue motions. Focus on organizational change, adoption, and lessons learned.

sessions.title: The Wonderful Company: Modernizing Warehouse Operations with AI Agents
sessions.description: Discover how The Wonderful Company is modernizing its warehouse operations with Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM AI Agents. This session explores three seeded AI agents designed to bring conversational intelligence directly into warehouse workflows: Inventory Expiry Assistant, Wave Research Advisor, and Task Management Assistant. Learn how these agents help teams proactively manage expiring inventory, quickly investigate wave allocation and performance, and identify at-risk orders while prioritizing and assigning tasks—all through intuitive, natural-language interactions within Oracle SCM experiences.

sessions.title: Modernizing Airline Operations with Exadata Cloud@Customer and AI
sessions.description: Modernizing mission-critical systems requires balancing innovation with operational reliability. Join United Airlines and Oracle to learn how United approached the modernization of critical database infrastructure using Oracle Exadata Cloud@Customer, Oracle Customer Success Services, and Oracle support services. Hear how the initiative helped improve availability, performance, resilience, and operational efficiency. The session will also explore how United is extending this foundation with Oracle AI Data Platform and related data capabilities to help bring operational and analytical data together, support predictive maintenance and operational intelligence, and provide a foundation for future AI initiatives.

sessions.title: Scaling Generative AI for Enterprise Customer Experience
sessions.description: As an Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Generative AI customer, Intermedia has evolved from individual AI use cases to a broader strategy focused on agent productivity and customer experience. Working with Oracle, Intermedia has expanded its use of generative AI across service operations, including case summarization, agent assistance, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), quality insights, and AI-assisted onboarding. Hear how Intermedia developed a practical approach to scaling AI adoption, applied AI to support operational improvements, and continues to evolve its customer experience platform.

sessions.title: How AI Reduced Time and Improved Intelligence at Little Bear Produce
sessions.description: At Mythics, we use AI to simplify processes and improve business outcomes. Working with Little Bear Produce, a Texas-based grower and shipper of fresh produce, we integrated data from the Famous ERP platform to support analytics and reporting. Traditionally, analyzing and mapping ERP data structures would take five to six weeks. By leveraging AI-assisted analysis, we reduced that effort to less than one week. AI rapidly identified key data relationships and data flows, enabling our team to focus on higher-value activities such as analytics development and reporting. The result was faster delivery, reduced project risk, and improved access to ERP data without disrupting existing operations.

sessions.title: Is Your Oracle ERP Compliance-Ready for the Next Wave of Regulations?
sessions.description: As indirect tax regulations evolve and e-invoicing continuous transaction controls (CTCs) expand worldwide, including major changes like Brazil's tax reform, organizations face growing pressure to modernize compliance while reducing complexity. What if tax determination, e-invoicing, reconciliation, and compliance could run directly inside Oracle Cloud ERP? Discover how organizations are replacing siloed point solutions and fragmented compliance processes with an embedded end-to-end approach that reduces complexity for IT and tax teams. Hear how NHS streamlined e-invoicing within Oracle, then see a live demonstration of the compliance lifecycle running natively within Oracle, from transaction processing through reporting and filing.

sessions.title: From Industry Expertise to Agentic Action
sessions.description: Across industries, high-value work still depends on people navigating disconnected systems, interpreting policies, and coordinating decisions. AI agents can turn that expertise into connected, governed action. See how Oracle AI Agent Studio for industries helps organizations build purpose-built agents that understand industry context, securely access enterprise capabilities, and orchestrate work across applications and services. Through practical scenarios across multiple industries, learn how reusable assets, governed discovery, customer-specific access, and secure agent collaboration help teams move from a high-value use case to scalable agent experiences built for enterprise trust and control.

sessions.title: Scaling Industrial AI From Model Training to Timely Decisions
sessions.description: Manufacturers generate large volumes of machine data, but turning that data into timely business decisions can be challenging. Tractian uses specialized AI to help teams identify potential equipment failures and act on industrial data faster. As its platform has grown, Tractian has turned to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure to support its infrastructure needs. Learn how Tractian is scaling industrial AI and translating complex machine data into actionable insights that can help manufacturers make more informed decisions.

sessions.title: Starian’s Cloud Strategy for Innovation and AI Readiness
sessions.description: Starian needed a cloud platform to support its growing SaaS operations while helping improve performance, manage infrastructure costs, and give engineering teams greater flexibility to modernize. Using Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, Starian streamlined software delivery and maintenance operations while building a scalable foundation to support growth. Provisioning improvements can also help engineering teams create innovation labs, experiment with emerging technologies, and advance modernization initiatives. Learn how Starian is using cloud modernization to support operational efficiency, continued innovation, AI readiness, and future growth.

sessions.title: IRIS Is Coming: How Avalara and Versori Use AI to Save Your 1099 Filing
sessions.description: The IRS is retiring FIRE, the 40-year-old system enterprises have relied on for 1099 filing. Starting Tax Year 2026, all organizations must transition to IRIS, where data accuracy requirements are significantly more stringent. The challenge? Vendor data is rarely consolidated in one place; it is dispersed across ERPs, spreadsheets, and payment systems, and generic AI chatbots are not built to unify it securely. Avalara and Versori will show you how purpose-built AI integrates your systems to get your 1099 data filing-ready in days rather than months, backed by a real customer success story. Walk away with an actionable plan to meet the deadline smoothly and eliminate the January scramble.

sessions.title: Winning Beyond the Track: Fusion Applications at Oracle Red Bull Racing
sessions.description: Championship performance is built long before race day. Join Brian Jones of Oracle Red Bull Racing and an Oracle leader to explore how Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications and embedded AI power the business behind one of Formula 1’s most demanding teams. From finance, planning, and HR to customer experience, Oracle Red Bull Racing is connecting data to improve decisions, manage complexity, develop talent, support cost-cap planning, and deepen fan relationships. Discover how a connected cloud platform turns AI ambition into operational value—helping the team act faster when every marginal gain matters.

sessions.title: Building an Enterprise AI Foundation for Finance Intelligence
sessions.description: State Street is exploring how Corporate Functions IT can transform Finance by building on trusted systems of record, including Oracle Fusion ERP for the core ledger and Oracle Revenue Management and Billing for custody-client billing and invoicing. The opportunity is to connect these systems with the broader approved data estate, including Databricks and other enterprise data sources, to give Finance a more complete, timely, and governed view of its operations. This chat will explore how Oracle AI Data Platform could provide the governed data and AI foundation, while an Industry Intelligence Platform could add the finance context that connects clients, services, contracts, billing, revenue, receivables, costs, the ledger, and controls. Together, these capabilities can help curate trusted finance insight across systems while preserving the role of existing systems of record.

sessions.title: From PeopleSoft to Fusion Cloud: Oceaneering’s AI-Guided Journey
sessions.description: Oceaneering modernized operations by transitioning from on-premises PeopleSoft to Oracle Fusion Cloud. Using Oracle AI Success Navigator and starter configurations as part of its change-management approach, the organization supported deployment planning, quarterly updates, and continuous innovation. AI-assisted capabilities also became part of Oceaneering’s approach to release planning and organizational change, helping make technology changes easier for teams to understand and adopt. Attendees will learn how Success Navigator and disciplined change management can support adoption, planning, and cross-functional decision making.

sessions.title: Clayton Homes, Grant Thornton & Oracle: Driving Outcomes with Applications & AI
sessions.description: What does it take to turn AI ambition into measurable business results? Join Clayton Homes, Grant Thornton, and Oracle for a candid look at how customers, implementation partners, and technology providers can work together to accelerate transformation. Through the "three-legged stool" model, learn how Oracle Fusion Applications created the foundation for operational excellence and how embedded and generative AI are unlocking new levels of productivity, insight, and innovation. Hear real-world lessons on governance, adoption, change management, and business value, and leave with a practical blueprint for building a scalable, AI-powered enterprise.

sessions.title: Beyond Fusion: Process-Driven AI Agents for the Real Enterprise
sessions.description: Oracle Fusion AI Agents excel when processes live entirely within Fusion. Most enterprises, however, span JD Edwards, E-Business Suite, SAP, and other systems, making Fusion-only automation incomplete. This session compares two approaches: Oracle AI Agent Studio orchestrating across systems via REST, MCP, and A2A, and agents built with APEX 26.1 on Oracle AI Database 26ai that use Fusion, JD Edwards, and EBS as tools. Both approaches are strengthened by a process model repository that defines end-to-end workflows and business rules, providing grounded context, guiding execution, and improving auditability. See real-world examples including HCM self-service, compensation recommendations, and sales order creation.

sessions.title: 3 steps to closing the workflow gap killing AI ROI
sessions.description: AI only delivers ROI if it is not trapped in broken workflows. As organizations accelerate AI investments, disconnected processes, siloed data, and legacy systems continue to slow decisions, limit automation, and prevent scale. Through Utah County's transformation from a 20-plus-year legacy environment to Oracle Cloud ERP, SCM, and EPM, discover how an AI-ready digital foundation can eliminate workflow silos and unlock real AI ROI. Join this session to learn how to orchestrate intelligent workflows across Oracle and non-Oracle environments, connecting data, applications, and processes to streamline operations, scale AI adoption, and turn AI investments into measurable business returns.

sessions.title: Ricoh USA: Connecting What Customers Buy to What the Enterprise Delivers
sessions.description: Modernizing sales takes more than replacing applications. It requires a connected foundation across customer engagement, account planning, solution configuration, commercial commitments, and enterprise execution. Join Ricoh to hear how they have completed its sales CRM rollout and is building on Redwood to create a more intelligent seller experience. Ricoh will share its progress with AI, its work to simplify hardware and services renewals, and its plans for sales orchestration and automated account planning. Learn how a connected sales foundation can help sellers act with better context, improve adoption of new ways of working, and create the path toward agentic experiences that reduce friction and improve execution.

sessions.title: Oceaneering Connects People, Assets, and Operations Where Every Decision Matters
sessions.description: For Oceaneering, field service extends far beyond dispatching technicians—it supports complex onshore and offshore operations where people, assets, and equipment must stay connected in some of the world’s most challenging environments. To prepare for AI-driven service and modernize its technology landscape, Oceaneering is replacing multiple legacy and custom systems with one unified Oracle Fusion platform. Hear how they’re connecting field service with finance, HR, supply chain, inventory, and assets to help create a single operational view for the future of complex and remote service operations.

sessions.title: Progress Software Builds the Data Layer for Scaling and Accelerating Growth
sessions.description: Progress Software is a longtime Oracle Eloqua customer now implementing Fusion Unity Data Platform to strengthen the data foundation for its next phase of marketing and sales growth. In this customer success session, Progress and strategic implementation partner DEVGRU will share their practical journey from marketing automation to a more connected customer data strategy: consolidating data, building a golden record, activating trusted customer intelligence, and preparing for AI-supported growth workflows. Attendees will learn why Progress sees a customer data platform as essential, how the team is approaching adoption, and what it takes to move toward an agentic future where data helps identify opportunities and coordinate engagement.

sessions.title: How SITA Supports Cloud Cost Visibility and FinOps on OCI
sessions.description: SITA is supporting its cloud financial management practices by using Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) cost management capabilities to help identify unexpected spending earlier. By combining cost anomaly detection with cost analysis and budgeting capabilities, SITA has helped improve cost visibility, streamline investigation of unusual spending patterns, and support more proactive FinOps practices. This session shares implementation experiences, governance approaches, and lessons learned to help attendees understand how OCI capabilities can support financial accountability, help reduce operational risk, and help improve cloud cost management.

sessions.title: Skip Kubernetes: Run Containers Fast with OCI Container Instances
sessions.description: Not every containerized application needs Kubernetes. For teams that want to run containers quickly without managing clusters, nodes, or orchestration overhead, OCI Container Instances provides a simpler path from container image to running workload.

sessions.title: Tadweer’s AI Journey: From Ambition to Practical Use Cases
sessions.description: Discover how Tadweer is using AI capabilities in Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications Suite, along with guidance from Oracle Customer Success Services. This session explores how Tadweer is using these capabilities to support procurement efficiency and decision making, support its employee experience through Oracle Cloud HCM, and help accelerate financial close with AI agents in Oracle Cloud ERP. Hear what Tadweer and Oracle Customer Success Services have learned so far and practical lessons for turning AI ambition into business progress.

sessions.title: Build, Sell, and Deploy Trusted AI Solutions via Oracle Marketplace
sessions.description: AI is a defining growth opportunity for ISVs. Join Oracle executives to learn how OCI Marketplace can help turn differentiated AI solutions into global revenue. Explore how to strengthen your presence, accelerate enterprise buying with Private Offers, collaborate with channel partners through Multi-Party Private Offers where available, and align with Oracle co-sell motions. Leave with a practical path from listing to a repeatable go-to-market engine that helps customers discover, buy, and deploy solutions on OCI.

sessions.title: Supply Chain Planning Strategy and Roadmap: Driving Outcomes with AI
sessions.description: Traditional forecasting and optimization alone are no longer enough to manage accelerating demand and supply uncertainty or evaluate increasingly complex trade-offs. This session explores how built-in agentic AI capabilities can analyze disruptions more effectively, enable faster issue resolution, and help automate supply chain planning processes beyond traditional oversight. You can now focus on driving outcomes. The session also highlights industry-driven innovations and the future product direction across demand, supply, inventory, production, and sales and operations planning. A leading customer will also share how they adopted Oracle Supply Chain Planning to make faster and smarter planning decisions.

sessions.title: Logistics Product Strategy and Roadmap: Agentic Apps and Modern UX
sessions.description: Supply chain logistics networks are becoming increasingly complex as organizations navigate shifting trade policies, supply volatility, evolving customer expectations, and growing demands for operational efficiency and sustainability. Learn how Oracle Fusion Cloud Transportation Management, Global Trade Management, and Warehouse Management leverage built-in AI agents and agentic applications to help optimize transportation routing, enhance inventory visibility and fulfillment, help streamline trade compliance processes, and support reducing costs and lowering emissions. Join us to explore the latest innovations shaping the future of intelligent logistics and warehouse operations.

sessions.title: Supply Chain Execution Product Strategy and Roadmap: Maintenance Deep Dive
sessions.description: Asset-intensive organizations face growing pressure to improve asset reliability, maximize workforce productivity, reduce maintenance costs, and operate with greater agility. Explore the latest innovations in Oracle Fusion Cloud Maintenance, including AI-driven workflows, enhanced planning and scheduling, streamlined execution, and greater operational visibility. Hear from Pattern Energy as they share their transformation journey with Oracle Cloud Maintenance and the impact on their operations. Discover how organizations like Pattern Energy are modernizing maintenance and get a preview of the product roadmap and upcoming innovations.

sessions.title: How a Financial Services Subledger Powers the AI-Enabled Finance Workforce
sessions.description: The finance workforce is changing as AI moves from experimentation into core accounting and finance operations. A modern financial services subledger provides the governed foundation needed to scale AI with confidence while preserving control, auditability, and regulatory compliance. This session explores how leading institutions are combining financial services subledgers with AI-powered automation to streamline journal adjustments, reconciliations, exception management, and financial reviews. Learn how finance teams can reduce manual work, improve productivity, strengthen governance, and shift talent toward higher-value analysis, risk oversight, and strategic decision making in the era of agentic finance.

sessions.title: How Fusion Data Intelligence Delivers Agentic Intelligence at Enterprise Scale
sessions.description: As organizations expand their use of AI, the underlying data and analytics architecture becomes increasingly important. Fusion Data Intelligence brings AI capabilities together with enterprise data and analytics. Learn about Oracle's strategic vision for agentic intelligence and what it means for Finance, HR, Supply Chain, Sales, and Marketing. AI Agents can help surface cross-functional risks, detect anomalies, provide natural-language insights, and help users prioritize potential actions. Agentic Applications can bring AI-assisted insights and decision support into business workflows.

sessions.title: The Intelligent Workforce: AI-Powered HR with Fusion Data Intelligence
sessions.description: Traditional HR analytics often focus on what happened. Modern workforce intelligence should help leaders decide what to do next. Learn how Fusion Data Intelligence can extend workforce reporting with enterprise intelligence and pre-built analytics across recruiting, headcount, compensation, retention, performance, and talent management. Discover how AI-driven insights can help HR leaders identify workforce trends and risks, inform recruiting and retention strategies, and align talent planning with business objectives. You'll leave with practical examples of how organizations are using workforce data to inform decision-making.

sessions.title: AI-Generated Enterprise Ontology: AI That Can Use Your Business Context
sessions.description: Business leaders need AI that understands their business context. This session introduces Oracle Enterprise Ontology and Semantic Reasoning Engine, a shared semantic layer designed to support analytics and AI. Learn how shared business context can support Oracle AI Data Platform, Oracle Analytics Cloud, Fusion Data Intelligence, and enterprise agents. The Semantic Reasoning Engine helps translate business questions into queries and provides context for AI-generated responses, with capabilities for lineage and explainability. It also helps AI agents interpret data using defined business concepts.

sessions.title: Higher Education Reimagined: From Records to Outcomes with Oracle
sessions.description: Oracle Fusion Cloud applications help institutions connect finance, HR, and Student to manage complexity, reduce friction, and turn insight into action. As Oracle AI advances across the suite, it transforms systems of record into systems of outcomes, unlocking new ways to work, make decisions, and deliver connected experiences for students, faculty, and staff. In this session, Oracle's Higher Education Development team will share the Fusion Cloud roadmap for higher education. Then hear from institutions using Fusion Cloud ERP, Fusion Cloud HCM, and Student Financial Aid while deploying Oracle Student as they discuss their transformation journeys, lessons learned, and the value of a unified Oracle platform.

sessions.title: HCM Strategy and Roadmap: Orchestrating People, AI Agents, and Outcomes
sessions.description: AI is changing how work gets done. That shift is pushing organizations toward more dynamic, outcome-driven operating models and challenging HR with a new mandate: help leaders decide what should stay human-led, where AI can augment or automate execution, and how newly created capacity can be redirected toward the outcomes that matter most. Oracle is redefining human capital management for the autonomous enterprise. Discover how the latest Oracle Cloud HCM innovations help HR design and operate a human-agent workforce. Connect people, skills, roles, workforce plans, and AI-enabled execution in one adaptive model that keeps your people in the lead as work continues to evolve.

sessions.title: Winning with AI: Customer Perspectives on Business Value and Transformation
sessions.description: Realizing value from AI involves more than deploying models or agents—it also calls for a clear business strategy, appropriate governance practices, and a disciplined approach to adoption. Hear from Oracle Customer Success Services customers as they share how they are applying AI to support their business objectives, scaling AI initiatives across their organizations, and creating business value. Hear practical lessons on aligning AI initiatives with business priorities, overcoming adoption challenges, and working with Oracle Customer Success Services to support transformation through established delivery and value realization approaches.

sessions.title: Industry Innovation Every Industry Can Use
sessions.description: Some of the most transformative innovations aren't confined to the industries where they originated. Capabilities developed to solve complex industry-specific challenges—such as financial crime prevention, digital payments, capital project management, Voice AI, secure communications, loyalty, and lending and leasing—are now creating competitive advantage across every sector. Join technology leaders and customers as they share how they've applied these proven innovations beyond their original industries to accelerate transformation, improve operational efficiency, strengthen security, and deliver new business value.

sessions.title: Finance Reimagined: From Legacy to Connected Cloud to Autonomous Finance
sessions.description: What does it take to transform finance for the AI era? Hear senior finance and technology executives share their full transformation journey—from moving beyond legacy on-premises systems to integrated ERP and EPM unifying data and processes and building the foundation for a new finance operating model with embedded AI. They’ll share lessons on making the business case, simplifying and standardizing finance processes, experimenting with agents to automate operations, and expanding the use of AI to drive greater efficiency, improve decisions, and elevate finance as a strategic business partner. Learn what’s delivering value today, what’s next, and how leaders are navigating the journey toward autonomous finance.
sessions.audienceLevel: Advanced Long Term User Of Oracle

sessions.title: Practical Ways to Use AI to De-Risk and Accelerate Your Oracle Cloud EPM Project
sessions.description: Leading organizations are already using AI to de-risk Oracle Cloud EPM implementations, accelerate delivery, and get more from their investments—with tools available today. In this session, hear from Oracle Cloud EPM customers sharing real-world ways teams are using AI right now: accelerating documentation, generating Groovy scripts, analyzing Oracle release notes for regression impact, supporting testing cycles, and sustaining solutions with less effort. Hear directly from the people who've done it, and walk away with a practical playbook you can apply immediately.

sessions.title: MySQL Goes Full Stack: AI, Cloud Scale, and Open Source
sessions.description: AI is reshaping what developers expect from databases, and MySQL is evolving to meet the challenge. Join Oracle to explore the future of MySQL, from AI-assisted development with MySQL AI Studio to innovations in scalability, availability, and operational resilience for production workloads. See how MySQL HeatWave accelerates AI and analytics, learn how Oracle continues to invest in the open-source ecosystem, and hear how customers are using MySQL to build the next generation of cloud-native and AI-powered applications.

sessions.title: From Credential Check to Proof of Identity with OCI Biometrics
sessions.description: Passwords and traditional MFA verify credentials, but they don't always verify the person behind them. In this session, explore how Oracle extends identity assurance with facial, fingerprint, and voice verification to strengthen fraud prevention and reduce identity risk. Learn how modern biometric verification helps organizations meet regulatory requirements, protect high-value transactions, and establish trusted digital interactions across users, devices, and channels. See how Oracle is expanding biometric identity capabilities to support stronger, risk-based authentication for enterprise applications.

sessions.title: Oracle Classic Applications in AI Era: Modernization Without Disruption by DXC
sessions.description: Organizations operating PeopleSoft, E-Business Suite, JD Edwards, and Siebel applications want AI innovation without costly rip-and-replace implementations. Leading global organizations leverage DXC's AI-powered solutions to integrate OCI with business optimization and operational agents that automate tasks, accelerate approvals, and enhance support. Customer case studies will highlight measurable benefits, including improved efficiency, reduced manual processing, and faster business cycles. A live demo will showcase AI agents interacting with PeopleSoft in real time to retrieve information, initiate actions, and provide guided assistance. Supercharge your Oracle applications with DXC's AI-powered solutions.

sessions.title: Stop Paying the On-Premises Tax: The Economics of Going Multicloud
sessions.description: You can’t build the business case for multicloud by comparing infrastructure unit prices—that math misses the point. This session gives leaders a practical framework for the real economics: the cost of standing still, the operational burden the business carries today, the risk of being disrupted while you wait, and the value of moving faster. We’ll walk through how to evaluate multicloud as an enterprise-transformation decision, then align technical, finance, and business stakeholders around it in terms they each care about—growth, agility, risk, and return. Leave able to explain multicloud value to a CFO without reaching for a per-vCPU chart and to defend the number when someone pushes back.

sessions.title: What’s Next for Java? AI, Security, and Oracle’s Vision
sessions.description: As the #1 language for overall enterprise organizational use and cloud-native development, Java is everywhere AI needs to be. Advances in performance, scalability, deployment, integration, and security reinforce Java as a foundation for secure, high-performance applications. This session explores what is available today, how organizations are applying it, and where Oracle is taking Java next. Security is central to that roadmap. Oracle is making post-quantum cryptography (PQC) broadly available for Java, including standardized PQC algorithms and PQC-enabled TLS for current Long-Term Support releases. Hear from Oracle’s SVP of Java platform development about Java’s advances and roadmap across AI, security, and cloud-native development.

sessions.title: ERP Modernization: From Business Case to Enterprise Scale
sessions.description: Modern ERP programs are no longer one-time transformation efforts. They are becoming platforms for continuous reinvention. This session explores how organizations are building the business case, modernizing core processes, and creating the foundation for long-term agility and value. Hear how Graco is advancing a phased Oracle Fusion Cloud transformation, how Intralox is taking a phased approach from Oracle EBS to Oracle Cloud through HCM, Planning, WMS, and OTM, and how the State of Texas completed a large-scale ERP transformation. Together, these stories offer practical lessons for organizations navigating enterprise transformation.

sessions.title: Modernizing the Core: Asplundh's Oracle Powered Transformation
sessions.description: How does an industry leader modernize complex financial operations at enterprise scale? Learn how Asplundh Tree Expert, in collaboration with KPMG, is tackling this challenge by migrating legacy systems to Oracle's integrated cloud platform—including ERP, Field Service Management, and HCM/Payroll. In this session, you'll discover how Asplundh leverages Oracle’s embedded AI and intelligent automation to streamline its financial close, improve operational efficiency, and drive data-backed financial decisions that connect back-office strategy directly to operational execution.

sessions.title: Strategic AI for the Enterprise: Real Value from Avalara Delivered Responsibly
sessions.description: AI only matters when it delivers real value where your team already works, with capabilities you can trust. In this session, see how Avalara’s agentic AI for Oracle customers takes the grind out of tax and compliance, while keeping your data protected and your people in control of the decisions that matter. Discover a new way of working and meet new agentic teammates as we tour Avalara Aviator, a new agent hub, along with agents co-developed with Oracle in Fusion AI Agent Studio to simplify and master complex tax and compliance work.

sessions.title: Building Trustworthy AI: Where Privacy, Policy, and Practice Meet
sessions.description: As AI moves from pilot to production, trust is the price of admission. And trust isn't built by one team alone; it often emerges where privacy, governance, and operational execution meet. This panel brings together leaders at that intersection: a Chief Privacy Officer navigating data protection at scale, a finance transformation leader turning AI governance into operational impact, and an Cyber leader navigating AI's opportunity and risk. They will explore what it can take to operationalize trustworthy AI—from privacy-by-design and compliance to the guardrails and change management that help make governance stick. Attendees will leave with practical perspectives on building AI that is can be more innovative, defensible, and worthy of trust.

sessions.title: AI in One Click: OCI Accelerator Packs and NVIDIA cuOPT for Route Optimization
sessions.description: OCI Accelerator Packs make it simple to deploy production-ready NVIDIA software with no infrastructure overhead. This session showcases NVIDIA cuOpt as a flagship vertical use case, a GPU-accelerated optimization solver for fleet routing, supply chain, and last-mile delivery that solves in milliseconds what CPU solvers take hours to complete, available directly through the Oracle Cloud Marketplace.

sessions.title: Securing OCI: From Edge to SecOps with Cloudflare and Stellar Cyber
sessions.description: As organizations move critical workloads to OCI and accelerate AI adoption, security teams face a rising volume of vulnerabilities, threats, and configuration changes across infrastructure, applications, users, networks, and the Internet edge. Keeping up requires more than headcount—it requires automating routine security work. Oracle, Cloudflare, and Stellar Cyber show an integrated security architecture for OCI customers: Cloudflare protects the Internet edge—WAF, application security, SASE—while Stellar Cyber unifies Cloudflare telemetry with OCI and the broader ecosystem for AI-driven SecOps. See how teams delegate repeatable work to the platform, respond faster to threats, and focus analysts on decisions requiring human expertise.

sessions.title: Bringing AI to Exadata: Performance, Simplicity, and Scale
sessions.description: Exadata is engineered to deliver the performance, scalability, and operational simplicity required for today's most demanding Oracle AI Database workloads. Explore the Exadata architecture and key engineering innovations behind its performance, showing how database-aware software and high-performance hardware enable accelerated AI Vector Search, OLTP, analytics, JSON, Spatial, and Graph workloads. Learn how AI Smart Scan for Oracle AI Database, XRMEM, NVMe Flash, RoCE networking, and Exadata Exascale help improve performance and resource utilization, simplify operations, and provide a foundation for modern AI and database workloads. See how agentic AI capabilities can help administrators streamline Exadata fleet-management workflows.

sessions.title: AI and ML in your database: What's New and What's Next
sessions.description: Join this session to explore what’s new and what’s next for AI and machine learning in Oracle Autonomous AI Database and Oracle AI Database, with a focus on Oracle Select AI, the Select AI Agent framework, built-in MCP and A2A Server capabilities, and Oracle Machine Learning. Learn how these capabilities help developers and data teams build AI-native applications with enterprise-grade security and governance capabilities, develop in-database machine learning solutions, and enable organizations to keep sensitive data in the database when appropriate.

sessions.title: Data Security for the AI Era: Defending Against AI-Powered Threats
sessions.description: AI isn’t just transforming how enterprises innovate, it’s also accelerating cyberattacks. AI-powered threats can uncover new exploits, operate at unprecedented speed and scale, and turn any deployment vulnerability into an entry point to your databases. Join us to hear about Oracle’s three-part approach to defense. Secure at the source with Deep Data Security, SQL Firewall, and post-quantum cryptography to limit what rogue users, applications, and AI agents can do. Finance leaders need an ERP foundation that provides frictionless automation and always-current business data. Join this session to learn Oracle’s strategy for autonomous finance and how Oracle Cloud ERP continuously drives close readiness, working capital optimization, and faster innovation adoption while preserving human judgment where it matters most.

As Oracle advances the next wave of Fusion AI, Agent Studio is helping teams envision workflows where agents collaborate, learn from context and feedback, and deliver outcomes across text, voice, documents, and media. Alongside this future vision, we will also share best practices for building effective, scalable agent experiences that are ready for enterprise use.

sessions.title: Best Practices for Oracle Integration AI-Enabled Projects
