sessions.title: From Data to Enterprise AI: Oracle AI Data Platform Customer Panel
sessions.description: Hear directly from data, analytics, and AI leaders using Oracle AI Data Platform to transform fragmented enterprise data into production-ready AI. Moving beyond product demos, customers share why they chose Oracle, how they implemented the platform, and what it took to unify data engineering, analytics, data science, and AI agents on a common foundation. Learn how they integrated Oracle and third-party data, established governed data products and business semantics, and moved AI initiatives from experimentation to production. Discover the business value they achieved and the lessons learned along the way.

sessions.title: Fusion CX Strategy: Activate AI Investment to Grow Revenue and Customer Trust
sessions.description: Fusion customers have an advantage: finance, supply chain, product, service, and operations run on Oracle Fusion. Activate that foundation with your AI ecosystem to grow revenue and improve customer outcomes. See how Oracle Fusion Customer Experience Applications draw on the Fusion estate to accelerate revenue, protect margin, reduce churn risk, and strengthen trust. Demos show AI advancing from assisting practitioners where they work, to leading cross-functional enterprise work, to increasingly automating business and customer outcomes. Leave with a roadmap for combining better decisions × enterprise execution × scale to create an Enterprise AI Dividend that compounds as Fusion improves more decisions, transactions, and outcomes over time.

sessions.title: Foundation First: Building Intentional AI-Ready Oracle Platforms
sessions.description: Three very different industries, one shared discipline: build the foundation before you chase Al. Oracle CIO of the Year Rhett Rowan spent nearly a decade with Peloton Consulting Group unifying Liberty Energy's ERP, SCM, HCM, EPM, and analytics onto Oracle Cloud through 700%+ growth, now expanding into agentic Al. La Terra Fina took a deliberate two-phase approach with Peloton, building financial and planning foundations first before layering in Al-ready demand planning. Golden State Lumber is implementing a unified Oracle Cloud platform across all operations, ERP, HCM, SCM, and EPM. In this fireside chat, leaders from three companies discuss why a phased, patient rollout, not a big bang, is what earns a business the right to use Al well.

sessions.title: RevPro to RMCS: Forescout's Transformation with Oracle Fusion Applications
sessions.description: Forescout Technologies, a global cybersecurity leader protecting more than 88 million devices, managed revenue through a standalone Zuora RevPro subledger connected to its ERP system through batch interfaces, manual journals, and offline spreadsheets. As its subscription business scaled, the model could no longer keep pace. In this session, Forescout and Infovity share how they replaced RevPro with Oracle Fusion Cloud Revenue Management and Oracle Fusion Cloud Subscription Management to unify quote-to-revenue processes. Learn the migration playbook, including ASC 606 policy rebaselining, contract and balance conversion, a two-quarter parallel run, auditor sign-off, and measurable results enabled by a single source of truth.

sessions.title: Real Manufacturers, Real Momentum: Scaling Cloud, Value, and Building Agentic AI
sessions.description: Whether you are after go-live, mid-implementation, or still in design, the question is the same: How do you build for an era in which AI continually raises the bar for what is possible? This session brings together three manufacturers at different stages of their cloud journeys: one expanding a mature global cloud deployment with AI, one stabilizing a newly live environment, and one in phase zero with an agentic-first design. Hear practical insights on sequencing, change management, and building a foundation for what comes next.

sessions.title: From AI Ambition to Business Outcomes: Building a 90-Day Fusion AI Roadmap
sessions.description: Most organizations are not short of AI ideas. The challenge is knowing which will create measurable value, need process or data readiness first, and risk becoming disconnected experiments. Capgemini believes enterprise AI succeeds through disciplined prioritization, not isolated pilots. Through real-world use cases, this session shares a practical approach to prioritizing AI opportunities across Oracle Fusion ERP, HCM, SCM, and CX, assessing each against business value, complexity, process maturity, workforce impact, data readiness, and the right level of autonomy. Attendees will leave with a proven framework for turning a long list of ideas into a focused 90-day roadmap with clear outcomes, ownership, controls, and success measures.

sessions.title: De-Risk & Accelerate Your Move to Fusion Cloud with Celonis Process Intelligence
sessions.description: Moving to Oracle Fusion Cloud is more than a technology migration—it’s an opportunity to transform how your business operates. Powered by the Celonis Context Model, the Celonis platform transforms enterprise data into operational context to guide every stage of the Fusion journey—from building the business case and de-risking migration to proving value and accelerating AI adoption. Learn from leading organizations how Celonis helps build the business case and quantify the value of moving to Fusion Cloud, de-risk migration by uncovering legacy process complexity, customizations, and execution gaps, and maximize value after go-live by accelerating adoption, measuring business outcomes, and identifying opportunities for AI.

sessions.description: How do you move from complex legacy systems to autonomous financial operation? Learn how they achieved a reduction in manual touchpoints across payables and GL. Discover the "AI-in-action" that powers their straight-through processing, including intelligent document recognition (IDR) and automated close cycles with FCCS and ARCS. sessions.title: The Financial Services Finance Transformation Playbook: From Vision to Value

Explore how financial institutions can connect people, processes, data, technology, and AI to help enable a more intelligent, flexible, and future-ready finance organization.

sessions.title: Secure Multi-Agent Workflows: Memory-Grounded Governance with NVIDIA and Oracle

See how Oracle AI Agent Memory and NVIDIA OpenShell work together to enforce governed, auditable access in real time, scoping permissions dynamically as work changes, so agents stay productive without becoming a security or compliance risk.

sessions.title: AI Designed My Database. How Did It Go?
sessions.description: Creating an Oracle Database schema has never been easier. With your favorite LLM, you can generate an initial data model and DDL in minutes. But is the design ready for production? What happens if your application becomes an overnight success? Will the AI-generated schema you deployed on day one still deliver the performance, scalability, and reliability your application demands? This session explores how to move from AI-generated prototypes to production-ready database designs using Oracle AI Database. You'll learn how to validate, optimize, and evolve your schema as application requirements and workloads evolve.

sessions.title: Trusted Agentic AI with Oracle AI Database
sessions.description: Oracle AI Database has evolved into an AI-native agentic platform. Learn how agents can find relevant data using AI Vector Search across all kinds of data; how they can reason on data with database-native semantic knowledge, RAG, and agent flows; how they can remember key information with a unified agent memory core; how they can scale to the needs of any workload and any scale. Also learn how to protect your data from AI-era threats using deep data security and industrial-strength fault-tolerance; how to eliminate lock-in with multicloud, open standards, and AI for any data, wherever it resides. Finally, learn how to rapidly build and deploy enterprise agents with database-integrated agent builders and agentic solutions.

sessions.title: Stay Current, Reduce Risk: What’s New in Exadata Database Service Maintenance
sessions.description: As cyber threats become more sophisticated, keeping database software current is essential for reducing security and operational risk. Learn what's new in Oracle Exadata Database Service software maintenance, including recent enhancements that help teams plan and automate software updates across the stack, reduce operational risk, and keep environments current. Gain a clearer understanding of available maintenance options, current Exadata Database Service capabilities, and practical best practices for keeping systems secure and up to date.

sessions.title: PostgreSQL: The Hidden Cost of "Good Enough”
sessions.description: PostgreSQL is popular, capable, and inexpensive, making it a reasonable choice for many workloads. The challenge comes when “good enough” becomes the default enterprise database strategy. A license is a line item. An estate is what you run. Availability, security, backup, monitoring, integration, skills, and duplicated operations drive the real cost. As AI brings agents closer to operational data, fragmentation adds governance and risk. If Oracle AI Database already runs your most important data, does another platform simplify your architecture or just hide the cost? Using customer examples, this session breaks down the costs organizations overlook, consolidation in practice, and a framework for evaluating your database estate.

sessions.title: Put Oracle Operational Data to Work for AI
sessions.description: Your most valuable operational data may need to stay where it is, in Oracle Database or Exadata Cloud@Customer. Learn how Oracle AI Lakehouse can extend analytics and AI to that data without requiring database migration or changes to operational applications. Explore approaches for securely using Oracle data for governed analysis and AI while Oracle Database remains the system of record. This session focuses on practical ways to gain more value from existing Oracle data while maintaining established operational environments.

sessions.title: Consumer Industries Meet Up: From Insight to Action

Discuss practical approaches to identifying high-value opportunities, preparing data, building trust, and scaling AI across finance, merchandising, operations, supply chain, and workforce productivity and more. Bring your questions, experiences, and lessons learned, and engage directly with Oracle product leaders on the priorities and direction helping consumer-industry organizations turn AI insight into action.

sessions.title: From Complexity to Clarity: A New Era of Business Reinvention

Join leaders from Driscoll’s, Grupo Bimbo and Ventura Foods as they share the real stories behind their transformation journeys. From modernizing legacy systems and harmonizing global operations to strengthening supply chains, enabling data-driven decisions, and accelerating organizational change, hear the lessons, breakthroughs, and bold decisions that are helping these organizations build more agile, resilient, and future-ready enterprises.

sessions.title: Humans in the Lead: From Readiness to Workforce Reinvention

Discover practical strategies for accelerating adoption, strengthening engagement and building the capabilities needed to sustain lasting transformation.

sessions.title: Powering the Next Era of Enterprise AI

Understand how OCI is redefining AI infrastructure through industry-leading price-performance, breakthrough innovation, best-in-class AI clusters, and broad choice across CPUs and GPUs, all engineered for security, reliability, and efficiency. Explore how OCI and Oracle Database help enterprises put mission-critical data to work with AI—securely and reliably, with the freedom to deploy anything, anywhere.

A customer shares the use case behind this architecture: reducing days of manual reporting to minutes of agent-driven insight. Whether you run ERP, financials, or custom apps on Oracle, see how your database becomes an active participant in AI-driven decision making.

sessions.description: Can Oracle AI Database@AWS deliver Exadata-class performance, resilience, and security at true enterprise scale? We walk through multi-AZ ODB network deployments, hub-and-spoke connectivity across on-premises and multiple AWS VPCs, and design trade-offs between centralized traffic inspection and low-latency direct peering. sessions.title: Maximize Your OCI Investment for Agentic AI and Mission-Critical Workloads
sessions.description: Agentic AI is reshaping enterprise workflows by bringing orchestration, inference, and training together across CPU and GPU infrastructure. sessions.title: Quantum Comes to the Enterprise Cloud
sessions.description: Quantum computing is moving closer to the enterprise cloud. This session explores how Oracle and Quantinuum plan to integrate the Helios quantum computing system directly into OCI alongside GPU and HPC infrastructure. Learn how this approach can give developers managed access to quantum hardware, open hybrid programming tools, built-in calibration and advanced capabilities for developing and implementing fault-tolerant protocols without requiring specialized facilities or separate infrastructure. We’ll examine how quantum-classical workflows could support optimization, simulation, sampling, scientific discovery, and AI, while helping organizations move from experimentation toward practical, governed quantum applications.

sessions.title: Mind the Gap: Connecting Clouds Without Complexity
sessions.description: Multicloud has become the reality for modern enterprises, but connecting cloud environments often introduces unnecessary complexity. Learn how OCI Multicloud Interconnect provides a standardized, managed approach to securely connecting Oracle Cloud Infrastructure with leading cloud providers—without rearchitecting your existing network. This session explores multicloud architecture patterns, deployment considerations, and real-world use cases that simplify connectivity, reduce operational overhead, and enable consistent networking across cloud environments. We’ll also share how Oracle’s multicloud networking strategy continues to evolve to support the next generation of enterprise applications and AI workloads.

sessions.title: From Helidon with Love: High-Performance AI Agents in Java with LangChain4j
sessions.description: AI agents are moving from demos to business-critical systems, and Java teams need a practical path to build them without abandoning enterprise standards. This session shows how Helidon and LangChain4j can implement high-performance agentic applications with intent classification, routing, RAG, model selection, tool calling, and MCP integration. We will walk through the architecture of a Helidon-based expert assistant, show how to separate responsibilities across agents, optimize model usage for cost and latency, and package the result as a production-ready Java service.

sessions.title: Breaking the Walled Garden: The Engineering Behind Oracle Database@Everywhere
sessions.description: For years, multicloud meant choosing between "split-stack" latency or complex data replication. Today, Oracle has fundamentally rewritten the rules by deploying OCI hardware and its management "brain" directly into the heart of our competitors' data centers. This session dives into the architecture of Oracle Database@Azure, @Google Cloud, and @AWS, and how we built a unified Multicloud Control Plane that spans the globe.

sessions.title: From HR to Total Workforce Management: Reinventing how people operate
sessions.description: Reinvent how your people operate. While automation accelerates, the goal isn't simply automating work—it's removing friction so people can focus on what matters most. Join KPMG Human Capital Advisory leaders to explore the evolution from traditional HR to Total Workforce Management (TWM). Discover how TWM bridges the Ulrich model with the agentic era, orchestrating employees, contractors, and digital labor across HR, IT, finance, and supply chain. Learn how human-centered design, single-pane-of-glass experiences, and behavioral nudges uplift managers, modernize operating structures, and drive better business outcomes.

sessions.title: Frontier AI Security: The Attack Is Automated. Is Your Defense?
sessions.description: Agentic AI is proliferating faster than the governance frameworks meant to contain it. Agents operate with privileged access, act autonomously across systems, and persist credentials in ways existing controls were not designed to detect. Meanwhile, frontier AI is surfacing vulnerabilities faster than patch processes can absorb. For organizations running complex Oracle estates, that pressure is accelerating the case for AI-driven automation across patching and modernization, turning manual quarterly cycles into continuous, AI-led ones. Learn from Seaspan about the emerging threat model and shifts that let organizations govern access, accelerate remediation, and modernize without sacrificing control.

sessions.title: Modernizing Oracle 1P Apps: Infrastructure Resilience Meets Agentic AI
sessions.description: Application and infrastructure teams face a constant squeeze between business-driven AI innovation and strict "five nines" uptime requirements. For cautiously modernizing on-premises setups, updating stacks can feel risky. This session shows how to safely modernize Oracle apps—like E-Business Suite, PeopleSoft, and JD Edwards—using Google Cloud’s high-performance infrastructure and Gemini. Discover proven blueprints for seamless cloud migration and agentic AI integration via Gemini Plugins, skills, and connectors. We will highlight Strategic Education Inc., which migrated PeopleSoft to Google Cloud using Oracle Database@Google Cloud to power their AI journey. Learn to boost app and database performance on secure infrastructure.

sessions.title: Stop Piloting, Start Scaling
sessions.description: Ready to go from disconnected AI pilots to an enterprise scale with measurable ROI? You don’t need more tools, you need connected governance: an integrated model that connects the heart of the business with the rest of the operating ecosystem, built around a single accountable focal point. Hear multiple real life stories of Fortune 500 companies who have lived the journey from early experimentation to building the guardrails, accountability, and platforms needed to deploy AI with confidence. You'll hear why effective governance accelerates decisions rather than blocking them, and how it helps organizations move faster and with greater trust, underpinned by Oracle Agent Studio enablement.

sessions.title: What It Takes to Build an AI-Powered Enterprise: Insights from DHL and Mount Sinai Health Systems
sessions.description: As AI moves from pilots to enterprise-wide adoption, business leaders face a new challenge: translating innovation into measurable outcomes. In this executive discussion, DHL, Mount Sinai Health Systems and Wipro will share perspectives on the future of AI-powered enterprises. Explore how organizations can use AI to modernize operations, empower employees, improve decision-making, and drive efficiency at scale, with a focus on examples for the Finance function. The session will highlight practical experiences, key lessons learned, and the strategic considerations shaping the next wave of enterprise transformation.
sessions.audienceLevel: Advanced Long Term User Of Oracle

sessions.title: Accelerate Your AI Apps with Oracle True Cache
sessions.description: Traditional caching improves performance but often shifts consistency, invalidation, and cache management into application code. Learn how True Cache accelerates read-intensive workloads through automated data loading, continuous refresh, elastic scalability, and enterprise-grade security. Deploy it in OCI, other public clouds, hybrid environments, or on-premises to keep frequently accessed data close to applications. Explore how semantic caching with Oracle AI Vector Search can accelerate RAG and AI inference while keeping data fresh and consistent across multicloud environments.

sessions.title: Patch Without the Outage Window: Stay Current When Attackers Move Fast
sessions.description: The days of annual database patching are over. As cyber threats evolve and attackers move faster, organizations need continuous, low-disruption patching to reduce risk. In this session, Oracle database experts will demonstrate modern patching strategies using RUs, MRPs, CSPUs, Oracle AutoUpgrade, Oracle Update Advisor (OUA), and Oracle RAC rolling patching to help reduce risk and downtime. Learn how Oracle AutoUpgrade can help automate patch download, deployment, and validation, how Oracle RAC can support rolling patching with reduced disruption, and how to evolve your patching approach to meet changing operational demands. Customer examples, practical recommendations, and lessons learned will help guide your modernization strategy.

Leave with practical lessons and a framework for identifying and pursuing value from enterprise AI initiatives.

sessions.title: Open Data. Open Models. Enterprise Control.
sessions.description: Build AI on your terms. This session explores how OCI Enterprise AI is being designed around openness, portability, and choice—so organizations can use the right models, data platforms, and deployment approaches for each workload. See how OCI combines enterprise-grade infrastructure with open technologies such as PostgreSQL and Kafka to help reduce lock-in, simplify integration, and preserve control over data and AI strategy. Leave with a practical view of how an open foundation can help teams innovate faster, scale confidently, and govern AI without closing off future options.

sessions.title: Local Control, Partner-Led Growth: Oracle Alloy’s Cloud Business Model
sessions.description: Customers want to know who operates their cloud, who can access systems, how data and traffic cross boundaries, and which laws govern operations. This session shows how Oracle Alloy helps partners build locally operated, branded clouds with control over customer experience, commercial models, services, and operational boundaries. Learn how partners can turn sovereign AI into a trusted local offer, add managed and industry services on OCI, and use Reserved Regions for dedicated capacity and stronger segregation. Leave with a practical blueprint for turning sovereignty into partner-led growth.

sessions.title: Ask Your Data Anything: Connect with Google Cloud, Azure, AWS, and OpenAI
sessions.description: Your teams already live inside AI assistants—the ones built into AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud. This session shows how Oracle AI Database Agent lets those assistants query your live enterprise data in plain language and get trusted answers back, with database identity, governance, and fine-grained access controls fully intact. Through live demonstrations, see it translate natural language into SQL and return real-time insight—the same governed Oracle data answering through whichever cloud's assistant your users prefer, no copies and nothing left ungoverned. That's the multicloud payoff: one trusted source of truth, reachable from every AI tool your organization already runs.

sessions.title: Teaching an AI Agent Your Business: Deep NL2SQL and the Knowledge Behind It
sessions.description: Discover how Deep NL2SQL enables natural conversations with enterprise data and improves through human feedback and iterative knowledge engineering. Explore how a guided workbench organizes enterprise knowledge into a Business Knowledge Graph for efficient search and retrieval, while Unified Agent Memory preserves conversational context. AI-Shift, a Japan-based leader in AI-driven workflow automation, will demonstrate the use of Deep NL2SQL into their conversational AI solutions.

sessions.title: AI-Driven Multicloud Management: What's New and What's Next
sessions.description: As enterprises accelerate AI adoption across distributed environments, observability and management must evolve beyond reactive monitoring into intelligent, automated operations. This session presents Oracle's latest strategy and publicly shared roadmap for AI-driven operations across multicloud and on-premises environments. Learn how OCI Observability and Management services together with Enterprise Manager 24ai provide comprehensive full-stack observability, intelligent diagnostics, and automated operations that help IT and DevOps teams improve productivity, reliability, and operational agility. We will also highlight new GenAI driven innovations for applications, databases, infrastructure, Exadata, and multicloud environments.

sessions.title: Bring Cloud and AI to On-Premises Data with Base Database Cloud@Customer
sessions.description: Many organizations need cloud database services that bring AI capabilities to on-premises data while keeping that data in their own data centers. Oracle Base Database Cloud@Customer provides a cost-effective hybrid cloud solution with Oracle-managed infrastructure, cloud automation, on-premises data residency, and low-latency access to existing applications. Learn how to modernize departmental databases, remote sites, and other on-premises environments while enabling AI applications and benefiting from the simplicity and operational efficiency of Oracle Base Database Service at your location.

sessions.title: Autonomous AI Lakehouse: What's New and What's Different
sessions.description: Agents need more than raw access to data. They need trusted context, governed permissions, reliable pipelines, and a shared semantic understanding of the business. This talk covers how the Autonomous AI Lakehouse helps connect private enterprise data to agentic AI across live data sources, including object stores, databases, other clouds, and SaaS applications. Through a central catalog, rich semantic layer, open Iceberg support, unified security, and Exadata performance, organizations can help enable agents to query live enterprise data where it resides, with availability across OCI, AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure.

sessions.title: No Need to Pick a Data Model: Build Apps That Can Use Any Model
sessions.description: AI applications rarely start with a perfect data model. Requirements evolve quickly, data comes in many formats, and developers need to combine business records, documents, metadata, vector embeddings, and search into one seamless application experience. In this session, learn how Oracle AI Database combines JSON, relational duality views, AI Vector Search, and enterprise-grade data management to support this flexibility. We will show how this approach helps developers build AI applications faster and adapt as requirements evolve while relying on a platform trusted for mission-critical workloads.

sessions.title: Developer Demo: Building Production-Ready AI Agents
sessions.description: Building an AI agent for a demo can be straightforward. Engineering one for retries, partial failures, read-heavy workloads, and regional data placement is more complex. In this all-demo session, we build a Spring Boot support-ticket workflow on Oracle AI Database. Oracle Transactional Event Queues (TxEventQ) support events through Apache Kafka APIs, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Generative AI creates summaries and embeddings, Oracle True Cache helps offload reads, and Oracle AI Vector Search helps identify related tickets and policies. We also demonstrate regional placement of selected data, blockchain tables for approval history, and Oracle Transaction Manager for Microservices (MicroTx) for workflows spanning transaction boundaries.

sessions.title: 5 lessons from innovative leaders on turning AI ambition into ROI
sessions.description: When AI scales, complexity scales faster. Leading organizations are learning how to manage both. Join Pearson and Atlanta Public Schools to explore how they are turning AI investments into measurable business outcomes. Pearson automated 70-80% of key cash operations with an Intelligent Cash Operations Agent integrated with Oracle ERP and identified new opportunities through an AI maturity assessment. Atlanta Public Schools is modernizing ERP, HCM, SCM, and PPM across 100+ schools serving 50,000+ students, embedding AI through a unified platform, governance framework, and workforce enablement strategy. In this session, learn how to identify high-value AI opportunities, govern agents, and scale AI adoption with confidence.

sessions.title: Connected for Change: Reimagining the Enterprise at Scale
sessions.description: Every transformation journey begins with a strong foundation. Join leaders from leading US organizations as they share how they are leveraging Oracle Fusion and AI to modernize operations, improve agility, and drive business value. From enhancing inventory visibility, planning, and operational efficiency through intelligent automation to reimagining enterprise processes that enable greater user adoption and smarter decision making, each organization brings a unique perspective. Through these real-world transformation stories, discover how a strong digital core and AI-powered innovation are helping organizations accelerate growth, improve performance, and build a foundation for the future.

sessions.title: 5 Agentic Experiences for Contract Teams to Accelerate Every Agreement
sessions.description: Contracts are no longer static documents—they are dynamic business assets that can help drive better decisions and more efficient execution across the organization. Join Oracle to explore five agentic experiences designed to help contract teams streamline agreement creation, review, negotiation, approvals, and ongoing management. Through practical examples and demos, see how agentic capabilities can help teams identify relevant information, surface recommended actions, streamline workflows, and support more consistent contract processes. Learn how data, process, and organizational foundations can help contract teams adopt agentic experiences and connect contracting activities across the business.

sessions.title: Supporting AI Readiness Through Digital Adoption at Texas Children's Hospital

Learn how this modernization supports faster decision making, streamlined operations, AI readiness, and improved visibility across clinical and business functions while helping healthcare leaders prepare for future innovation.

Using Oracle's Digital Ambulance as a featured example, we'll showcase how OCI Connected Devices technologies can accelerate decision making, improve operational efficiency, and deliver real-time business outcomes.

sessions.title: 20 Minutes to a Smaller Cloud Bill: Meet the OCI Multicloud Hub

sessions.title: Accelerating Your Move: Funding Programs for Oracle AI Database@AWS

sessions.title: Connect Data, Knowledge, and Actions with Agents on OCI Enterprise AI

See how we transformed manual releases into an AI-assisted DevOps process using GitLab CI/CD, SQLcl, and Liquibase, with version control, automated testing, governance, and multienvironment delivery. APEXlang (.apx) in APEX 26.1 enables APEX applications to be represented as readable source, supporting GenAI-assisted workflows from code review to generative development. See how Claude Code and APEXlang resources can help accelerate the modernization of legacy OAF pages to APEX.

sessions.title: AI in the Database: The Grand Tour
sessions.description: Oracle AI Database brings AI directly to your data, helping organizations unlock insights without moving information across systems. Join us for a guided tour of its integrated AI capabilities, including AI Vector Search across structured, unstructured, and multimodal data; retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounded in trusted enterprise content; and natural-language-to-SQL (NL2SQL) for more accessible database insights. We’ll also showcase agentic solutions that can reason, retrieve information, and take action within a governed database environment. See what’s possible when AI and data work together in the database.

sessions.title: 40 Seats, Zero Slides: The Database Patching Clinic
sessions.description: Patching does not have to mean long weekends, fragile runbooks, and familiar upgrade nightmares. Join this 45-minute, no-slides discussion with the Oracle Database Patching experts. Five small tables, up to 40 DBAs, your questions, and Oracle Database and Grid Infrastructure patching experts ready to help. Bring your patching concerns, downtime pressure, failed datapatch runs and let us discuss how often you should patch. We will discuss how to build a more agile patching practice, reduce risk through repeatable workflows. We want to help you simplify database upgrades and patching. Expect practical conversations, quick laptop demonstrations, and solutions you can take back to your next maintenance window.

sessions.title: Career Coach 2026
sessions.description: Experience the next evolution of the candidate journey with Career Coach 2026. This demo showcases new agentic capabilities including autonomous candidate messaging, interview guidance and scheduling support, application optimization and feedback, and personalized offer insights. See how intelligent agents provide proactive, personalized assistance at every stage of the hiring process, and get a glimpse of a future where these experiences seamlessly extend across mobile and messaging channels.

sessions.title: A Guided Tour of EPM AI Agents
sessions.description: This session will provide a quick tour across a rich array of AI agents in the Oracle Fusion Cloud Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) suite, covering planning, profitability, financial close, tax reporting, and enterprise data management use cases.
sessions.audienceLevel: Advanced Long Term User Of Oracle

sessions.title: AI-Agentic Apps for Modern Procurement
sessions.description: Discover how AI-powered agentic applications are transforming procurement by helping teams work smarter, respond faster, and make better decisions. In this session, we'll explore how intelligent assistants can streamline everyday procurement activities, surface actionable insights, and automate routine tasks while keeping users in control. Join us for a high-level look at the next generation of AI-driven procurement experiences and how agentic applications are reshaping the future of sourcing and procurement operations.

sessions.title: How Meta Is Applying AI to Improve Product and Order Operations
sessions.description: Meta is exploring how AI can help support product lifecycle and order management processes across engineering, supply chain, and operations teams. Working with Oracle Customer Success Services, Meta is evaluating AI-assisted approaches that can help improve engineering change processes, structure supplier and manufacturing data, simplify access to bill of materials (BOM) and product information through natural-language interactions, and identify potential order orchestration issues. Join this session to learn how these approaches can help reduce manual effort, support more efficient operations, and enable scalable enterprise processes.

sessions.title: Supporting Oracle Fusion Cloud Adoption with Oracle Guided Learning
sessions.description: Enterprise transformation requires employees to learn new ways of working. Join Terracon as it shares how Oracle Guided Learning supported its Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation through in-application guidance, contextual messaging, and AI-assisted content creation. Learn how embedded guidance helps employees adapt to new roles and processes and how Terracon is preparing its enablement approach for evolving AI capabilities. Attendees will gain practical ideas for user adoption, change management, and employee enablement.

sessions.title: Stay or Switch? From Reclaiming Oracle Investment to Unlocking Agentic AI
sessions.description: Barely a year after going live on Oracle HCM, Cherokee Federal faced the question many HR leaders ask but rarely admit: stay or switch? They chose a third path: reclaim. Join Cherokee Federal and Cloud Voyage Group for the turnaround story of stabilizing a live Oracle HCM environment across core HR, payroll, ORC, and complex integrations while rebuilding workforce trust. But the fix was just the beginning. Learn how the team has used Oracle functionality to deliver purpose-built solutions, including agentic AI workflows needed for GovCon compliance, using an audit-by-design approach that embeds audit readiness into every process. Discover how reclaim became the catalyst for innovation.

sessions.title: AI Agents in Action: AT&T's Finance Transformation Journey
sessions.description: AT&T is modernizing finance workflows using Oracle AI Agent Studio for Fusion Applications and AI agents. The initiative is helping automate elements of supplier-requirement monitoring, supplier self-service, accounts payable inquiries, and period-close activities, while supporting greater operational visibility and more consistent process controls. Learn how AT&T is applying conversational AI to help streamline finance workflows, reduce manual effort, and support strategic decision making, with practical insights for organizations exploring their own AI-enabled finance transformation.

sessions.title: From CPQ Foundation to Agentic Revenue: NetApp’s Next Chapter
sessions.description: NetApp has been on a journey to modernize its revenue operations, starting with its Oracle CPQ foundation. One year into that transformation, what has changed—and what comes next? Join NetApp and Oracle for a customer-led discussion on the lessons learned from modernizing CPQ, the business value delivered, and how a stronger revenue foundation is enabling NetApp to accelerate its AI journey. The session will explore where AI and agentic experiences can improve quoting and broader quote-to-cash processes, what NetApp has learned about preparing for those capabilities, and how the roadmap is shaping the next phase of revenue transformation.
sessions.audienceLevel: Advanced Long Term User Of Oracle

sessions.title: Navigate Your AI Journey with Oracle AI Success Navigator
sessions.description: Where should your organization start with Oracle AI, and how can you turn priorities into a workable plan? Join Oracle experts to explore how Oracle AI Success Navigator brings together AI guidance, best practices, and collaboration tools to support your cloud lifecycle from discovery, implementation, adoption, and ongoing innovation with Oracle Cloud applications. See how teams can review guidance for adopting AI, identify relevant capabilities, align stakeholders around priorities and adoption plans, and take practical next steps to enable Oracle AI capabilities that can help accelerate business outcomes.

sessions.title: Build Portable Multicloud Applications with Oracle AI Database
sessions.description: Applications increasingly run across multiple clouds, making consistent connectivity, security, and operations a challenge for developers. Learn how to build and deploy applications with Oracle AI Database across Oracle Cloud, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and on-premises environments without redesigning your application for each platform. Through practical scenarios, see how centralized configuration providers simplify database client configuration, identity, secrets, and monitoring for Java, Python, .NET, and C apps. This helps developers create secure, portable applications that are easier to deploy and manage for any hyperscaler deployment.

sessions.title: Lunch
Blueprint for Building the New Team and Operating Model with Agentic Service
sessions.description: Every organization wants to adopt AI, but becoming an agentic service organization can require more than deploying new capabilities. It involves new operating models, redesigned workflows, and alignment across business, IT, and service teams. In this session, explore a practical blueprint for evolving from AI-assisted service to agentic service. Learn how organizations are prioritizing use cases, preparing employees, modernizing operations, and helping scale AI adoption over time. Walk away with practical frameworks to help build your transformation roadmap and help accelerate your organization’s journey.

sessions.title: How to Find and Prioritize Growth Opportunities Across the Customer Lifecycle
sessions.description: Existing customers often hold important opportunities for cross-sell, upsell, renewal protection, and expansion, but many go-to-market teams still manage those motions through disconnected data, separate campaigns, manual sales effort, and low-context handoffs. This practical session introduces an operating model for finding, prioritizing, and activating customer growth opportunities across the lifecycle. Then hear from an Oracle customer who is adopting this model to support their marketing operations. Attendees will learn how to unify account intelligence, identify product fit and whitespace, assess buying group coverage, classify accounts into a suitable growth motion, and align marketing and sales around sales-ready action.

sessions.title: Accelerating Supply Chain Transformation with Oracle Fusion Cloud
sessions.description: J.M. Huber undertook a modernization of its supply chain and manufacturing operations through a nine-month implementation of Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications Suite, with an emphasis on standard capabilities and limited customization. Working with Oracle Consulting, the organization standardized business processes and completed its go-live while establishing a foundation that can support future AI initiatives. This session examines the leadership decisions, change management strategies, and implementation approach that supported the transformation. Attendees will gain practical lessons for planning and executing enterprise transformation programs.

sessions.title: How Avient Is Bringing AI into Performance Management
sessions.description: After more than five years using Oracle Fusion Human Capital Management, Avient is building on its cloud transformation as it explores AI in performance management. The global manufacturer will share how it is implementing Oracle AI capabilities to support managers and the employee experience, including its approach to goal setting and approvals through an internal process it calls the Goal Affirmation Journey. Attendees will hear how Avient evaluates and prioritizes AI use cases, lessons from its HCM transformation, and how its adoption of the Redwood user experience is supporting its approach to broader AI adoption.

sessions.title: Operationalizing Agentic AI in HR: Building a Scalable Governance Approach
sessions.description: Howmet Aerospace is building an operational foundation for deploying agentic AI in HR. Working with Oracle Customer Success Services, the organization developed an approach that incorporates continuous monitoring, AI quality evaluation, access controls, operational logging, runtime controls, cost management, and human oversight across the AI agent lifecycle. Learn how Howmet is applying these practices while preparing AI agents for production and explore practical considerations for managing and scaling AI operations in HR.
sessions.audienceLevel: Advanced Long Term User Of Oracle

sessions.title: Behind the Great AI Expedition: Agentic AI in Practice Across Four Industries
sessions.description: You played The Great AI Expedition on the show floor. Now meet the people behind the stops. Join leaders from four global companies across different industries for an open conversation about how they are using agentic AI in their businesses. Hear how they moved from the first idea to deploying AI agents, what changed in their day-to-day operations, and where they saw results. This is a peer-to-peer discussion, not a presentation, so bring your questions and compare notes with people working through similar challenges.

sessions.title: Analytical AI: Build the Model. Ask the Lakehouse
sessions.description: How can organizations turn Oracle data into actionable business insight? This session shows how existing Oracle Database and Oracle application customers can build on their data and reporting investments with Oracle Autonomous AI Lakehouse. Follow a sales example as AI-assisted modeling creates both Analytic Views and Essbase cubes, then ask questions and explore a multidimensional what-if scenario. See how semantic models capture business definitions, MCP connects agents to analytical tools, and A2A patterns coordinate specialized agents. Leave with practical ideas for applying conversational analytics to Oracle data and business models.

sessions.title: Deploying and Operating OCI as Private and Sovereign Cloud
sessions.description: Join fellow customers for a peer-led discussion on deploying OCI services across dedicated, sovereign, multicloud, public cloud, and partner-operated environments. We will explore practical lessons from customers running dedicated deployments alongside other OCI deployment models, including data residency, control, AI, data, and critical workload requirements, and modernization in locations with connectivity, latency, or infrastructure constraints. Bring your experiences, questions, and lessons learned.

sessions.title: How PayPal Built a Multicloud Foundation for Future Innovation
sessions.description: PayPal shares its approach to evolving its database strategy for mission-critical operations and planned innovation. The session examines its multicloud architecture using Oracle Exadata Cloud Service and Oracle Database@Google Cloud, including considerations for modernizing Oracle Database environments while building on existing investments. Attendees will hear practical lessons on modernization planning, multicloud architecture decisions, and operational considerations for enterprise transformation.

sessions.title: Expenses Agent Live: Redefining Expenses, Policy Controls, and Audit
sessions.description: See Expenses Agent live and discover how agentic AI turns expense management into an effortless, outcome-driven experience. Employees simply forward a receipt, and the agent captures the details, creates the expense report, checks policy, and keeps reimbursement moving. Then watch AI continuously review every expense, spot emerging risks, and recommend smarter policies and audit rules, driving outcomes such as faster reimbursement, stronger policy adherence, broader audit coverage, and less manual effort without adding friction for employees.
sessions.audienceLevel: Advanced Long Term User Of Oracle

sessions.title: AI on Your Own Data in 15 Minutes: No Copies, No Custom Plumbing
sessions.description: Your data is already sitting in Oracle Database inside AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud—so why copy it somewhere else just to ask an AI a question? In this 15-minute live demo, watch a hyperscaler AI service answer real questions against real operational data, right where it lives, with no data movement and no custom integration to build. See how the pieces connect across clouds so the AI you already use reaches the data you already trust. A fast, concrete look at the payoff of a multicloud footprint—and the quickest way to picture what it would do on your own data before you commit to a deeper session.

sessions.title: 5 Agentic Experiences for Sales Planning & Comp Leaders to Optimize Incentives
sessions.description: Compensation leaders need to do more than administer plans—they need to help align incentives with the right behaviors and business outcomes. Join Oracle for a demo-driven session featuring five agentic experiences that help teams build and refine incentive plans, surface performance insights, answer earnings questions, resolve disputes faster, and better support sellers and managers. See how Oracle Incentive Compensation uses AI to help reduce administrative effort, improve transparency, and help compensation teams continuously improve how they motivate and reward performance.
sessions.audienceLevel: Advanced Long Term User Of Oracle

sessions.title: Help End Users Adopt AI with Oracle Guided Learning
sessions.description: Introducing new AI capabilities into enterprise processes and workflows is only the beginning. End users also need guidance on when and how to use them. Join Oracle leaders to see how Oracle Guided Learning can support enterprise AI adoption. See how in-workflow guidance, self-service support, and change communications can support AI adoption as capabilities evolve. Explore how usage insights and feedback capabilities can help teams understand adoption and friction points, improve the user experience, and support more effective use of AI.

sessions.title: Build Enterprise AI Skills for Reimagining How Work Gets Done
sessions.description: AI changes both what teams can do and the skills they need to do it well. Join Oracle University leaders to explore a learning approach for business and technical roles. See how business teams can identify opportunities to reimagine workflows with AI, while technical teams build skills to develop, deploy, operate, and evolve AI-enabled systems. Learn how role-based learning, hands-on practice, and certification preparation through Oracle University can help organizations build enterprise AI skills and turn AI ideas into new ways of working.

sessions.title: Learn How Agents Reason with Location and Other Data Types in AI Lakehouse
sessions.description: Picking the next store location is a high-stakes decision. Poor site selection can lead to weaker sales, reduced accessibility, operational friction, and missed growth opportunities. Join us to learn how AI agents can help evaluate candidate locations by bringing together many of the factors an experienced team would consider, while reducing manual effort. See how agents can weigh customer access, local demand, competitors, suppliers, and market context across multiple sources and formats, including text, spatial data, documents, CSV files, and JSON documents. Instead of manually analyzing these data streams and stitching the results together, agents can help compare options more efficiently and provide supporting evidence.

sessions.title: Payables Agentic App Live: Touchless Invoice Processing, Compliance and Control
sessions.description: See the Payables Agent and Agentic App in action in a demo-led theater session with a preview of upcoming roadmap direction. Watch how Oracle helps automate supplier invoice processing across multiple formats and channels, including image-based invoices, e-invoicing, custom XML, and CSV. The demo will highlight Document IO extraction, adaptive learning, instruction-led mapping, policy upload and activation, invoice completion, anomaly detection, and exception resolution for a unified invoice processing experience. The session will also preview how Payables is expanding toward richer compliance and control, SOP-driven actions, period close readiness, and broader Payables operations assisted by agents and Agentic Apps.
sessions.audienceLevel: Advanced Long Term User Of Oracle

sessions.title: How to Convert Customer Signals Into Coordinated Revenue Growth Programs
sessions.description: Opens and clicks are getting less reliable, while the best signs of growth (renewals, usage, orders, service history) already sit in your enterprise data. Learn how Oracle Agentic Apps and AI help marketing and revenue teams turn those durable signals into growth motions, buying groups, targeted programs, and seller-ready context. Oracle's marketing team will share how they are putting this blueprint into practice to turn sales plays into coordinated marketing motions that drive growth.

sessions.title: Oracle AI Database in Practice: An Oracle ACE’s View of What Matters
sessions.description: What’s worth exploring in Oracle AI Database? Hear an Oracle ACE’s practitioner perspective, shaped by hands-on testing and real-world scenarios. We’ll dig into AI Vector Search, including vector data types, embeddings, similarity search, and HNSW and IVF indexes. We’ll also explore True Cache and SQL Firewall, with a practical look at performance, resilience, and security. Expect technical insights, demos, lessons learned, and candid observations, plus test environments and resources you can use to experiment on your own.
